E001.Epic Description: Enable property managers to add, update, and remove property listings, including detailed descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos to attract potential tenants.
E001.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to add property listings so that I can advertise available properties to potential tenants.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Property Manager can enter property details including name, address, description, property type, and photos.
System must validate entered data for completeness and correctness.
Upon successful submission, the property listing should be visible on the platform.
Property Manager receives confirmation of listing addition.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a form interface for property managers to enter property details such as name, address, description, property type, and upload photos. Ensure the form includes all required fields and provides a user-friendly interface.

Develop a data validation function on the backend to check the completeness and correctness of the entered property data. This function should verify that all fields are filled and the data formats for fields like address and email are correct.
Implement a database schema to store property listings. The schema should include fields for name, address, description, property type, and a mechanism to store photo URLs or binary data.

Create backend functionality to process the form data upon submission, save the valid data to the database, and handle any data validation errors by sending appropriate feedback to the user interface.

Develop the frontend functionality to dynamically display the newly added property listing on the platform immediately after successful submission. This should be done without the need for a page refresh.
Implement a confirmation mechanism that notifies the property manager of a successful listing addition. This could be in the form of an on-screen message or an email notification.

E001.Epic Description: Enable property managers to add, update, and remove property listings, including detailed descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos to attract potential tenants.
E001.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to update property listings to ensure all information is current and accurate.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Property Manager can select an existing listing and update any of the details including descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos.
System must validate updated data for completeness and correctness.
Changes should be immediately reflected on the platform upon submission.
Property Manager receives confirmation of listing update.

Tasks.Description: Create a user interface for property managers to select and view existing property listings. This interface should list all properties and allow selection for editing.
Design and implement a detailed edit form in the user interface that allows property managers to update descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos for the selected property listing.
Develop backend functionality to fetch existing details of a selected property listing to populate the edit form, ensuring the property manager can see current values before making updates.

Implement input validation on the property listing edit form to ensure that all provided data is complete and correct. This includes checks for blank fields and formatting checks for data such as images and text inputs.

Update the backend API to accept and process updated property listing data. Ensure the API can handle updates to text fields and file uploads for images, and integrate with the database to store the updated information.
Modify the database schema if necessary to support new types of data for property listings that may be introduced in the form of updated rules or amenities.
Implement real-time update capabilities on the platform to ensure that changes made by the property manager are immediately reflected on the platform without needing a page refresh.

Create a confirmation mechanism that notifies the property manager upon successful update of a property listing. This could be in the form of a pop-up notification or a redirection to a confirmation page.
Write unit tests to verify that the property listing update functionalities work as expected, including input validation, API processing, and database updates.
Conduct integration testing to ensure that the new updates work seamlessly with the existing platform features and that the user experience is consistent and error-free.
Document the feature updates and usage instructions for the property management dashboard, updating any existing help or tutorial sections relevant to managing property listings.

E001.Epic Description: Enable property managers to add, update, and remove property listings, including detailed descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos to attract potential tenants.
E001.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to remove property listings that are no longer available to rent.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Property Manager can select an existing listing and remove it from the platform.
System should prompt for confirmation before deletion to prevent accidental removals.
Once confirmed and removed, the listing should no longer be visible or searchable on the platform.
Property Manager receives confirmation of listing removal.

Tasks.Description: Design a UI element for property managers to view existing property listings. This should include a list or table view with options to select specific listings for further actions.
Implement a 'Remove' button for each property listing in the property manager's dashboard. Ensure this button is clearly visible and accessible next to each property listing.
Develop a confirmation dialog box that appears when the 'Remove' button is clicked. The dialog box should ask for confirmation to proceed with deletion to prevent accidental removals.
Create backend functionality to handle the deletion of a property listing from the database once the property manager confirms the action through the confirmation dialog.
Ensure that once a property listing is removed, it is no longer visible in the property manager’s dashboard and is not searchable or accessible from any other part of the platform.
Implement a notification system to send a confirmation message to the property manager once a listing has been successfully removed. This may include an email notification and/or an in-app alert.

Write unit tests to verify that the property removal feature works as expected under various scenarios, including attempting to remove non-existent properties and handling concurrent removal requests.
Conduct end-to-end testing to ensure the property removal process is integrated smoothly with the existing platform, checking both the frontend and backend components.
Document the new functionality in the platform’s help and user guide sections to assist property managers in understanding how to use the property removal feature.

E001.Epic Description: Enable property managers to add, update, and remove property listings, including detailed descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos to attract potential tenants.
E001.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to view detailed information of property listings so that I can oversee all listings under my management.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Property Manager can select a listing and view all details including descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos.
All details should be presented clearly and be easily readable.
Property Managers can navigate back to the listing overview seamlessly.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to store property listings details including descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos.
Create a backend API endpoint to retrieve property listing details by listing ID.
Develop a user interface component where property managers can select a property from a list to view its details.
Implement a detailed view page for property listings showing descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos in a clear and readable format.
Ensure that the property details page is responsive and the information is organized for easy reading on various devices.
Develop navigation controls on the property details page to allow property managers to return to the listing overview seamlessly.
Implement accessibility features on the property details page to enhance readability, including appropriate font sizes, contrast, and alt tags for images.
Conduct user testing with actual property managers to validate that the details page meets the criteria of clarity and navigability.
Optimize backend API for fast retrieval of property listings, ensuring a smooth user experience when accessing detailed listing information.
Document the user interface flows and API usage in the system's technical documentation for future reference and onboarding of new developers.

E001.Epic Description: Enable property managers to add, update, and remove property listings, including detailed descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos to attract potential tenants.
E001.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to search and filter property listings to easily find specific properties or types of properties.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Property Manager can use a search bar to enter search criteria.
Property Manager can apply filters such as location, property type, and availability status.
Results should update in real-time as filters are applied.
Listings matching the criteria are displayed; if no matches are found, an appropriate message is shown.

Tasks.Description: Implement a search bar component in the property listing interface. This component should allow property managers to enter criteria like property name or keywords.

Create a filter component that allows property managers to specify criteria such as location, property type, and availability status. This component should be integrated into the property listing page and allow multiple selections for each filter category.

Develop backend functionality to handle dynamic querying of property listings based on inputs from the search bar and filters. Ensure the system handles various combinations of searches and filters efficiently.

Implement real-time updating of the search results on the property listing page as search criteria or filters are changed by the property manager. Use AJAX or a similar technology to refresh the listing results without reloading the entire page.

Ensure that the property listings matching the search and filter criteria are displayed in a clear and organized manner on the property listing page. Each listing should include essential information such as name, location, type, and status.

Implement a feature to display an appropriate message when no property listings match the search and filter criteria entered by the property manager. This message should guide them to adjust their search terms or filter settings.

Conduct unit tests to verify that the search and filter functionalities are working as expected across different scenarios. Include tests for typical, boundary, and erroneous inputs to ensure robustness.

Perform integration testing to ensure that the new search and filter features work seamlessly with existing property listing management functionalities, such as adding, updating, and removing listings.

Prepare user documentation that explains how to use the new search and filter features, including screenshots and step-by-step instructions to assist property managers in using these features effectively.

Deploy the updated property listing search and filter functionalities to the staging environment for end-to-end testing by a selected group of property managers. Gather feedback and make necessary adjustments before final deployment.

E001.Epic Description: Enable property managers to add, update, and remove property listings, including detailed descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos to attract potential tenants.
E001.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to securely log in to manage property listings.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Login page accessible from the main website.
Secure authentication with username and password.
Forgot password and reset functionality.
Session timeouts for security.

Tasks.Description: Create a secure login interface accessible from the main website. This interface should include fields for username and password.
Implement backend authentication logic to validate the username and password against the database. Use secure hashing for password storage and comparison.
Develop a 'Forgot Password' feature that allows users to request a password reset link. This link should be sent to the registered email associated with the username.
Design and implement secure password reset functionality via the received email link, allowing the user to input a new password.
Implement session management to ensure session timeouts for enhanced security. Configure the system to automatically log out users after a predefined period of inactivity.

E002.Epic Description: Facilitate the creation, updating, renewal, and termination of lease agreements, including the use of templates, e-signing via DocuSign, and managing lease durations.
E002.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to create lease agreements using templates so that I can efficiently prepare contracts for new tenants.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Ability to select from predefined or previously used templates.
Customize templates with specific lease details (e.g., rent amount, duration).
Preview lease agreement before finalizing.

Tasks.Description: Develop a user interface component that allows property managers to select from a list of predefined or previously used lease templates. This interface should be intuitive and accessible from the lease creation dashboard.

Implement backend functionality to retrieve and display lease templates, including predefined templates and templates previously created by the user. Ensure these templates are fetched securely and efficiently from the database.

Create a form within the lease agreement creation module that allows property managers to customize templates with specific lease details such as rent amount, lease duration, and other relevant terms.
Develop validation logic to ensure all required fields in the lease customization form are completed and conform to expected formats and constraints (e.g., numeric values for rent amount).

Implement a preview feature that allows property managers to see a fully rendered view of the customized lease agreement before finalizing. This preview should reflect all customizations and be formatted as the final document.
Ensure the system's lease agreement preview feature includes options to edit, save, or cancel the process. This allows property managers to make modifications before the final submission.

E002.Epic Description: Facilitate the creation, updating, renewal, and termination of lease agreements, including the use of templates, e-signing via DocuSign, and managing lease durations.
E002.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want tenants to e-sign the lease agreements via DocuSign so that the lease process is expedited and legally binding.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Integration with DocuSign for e-signing functionality.
Notification to property manager when a tenant has signed the document.
Secure storage of signed documents accessible via the platform.

Tasks.Description: Research and select an appropriate DocuSign API plan that suits the platform's needs for e-signing functionalities.
Set up and configure the development environment to connect with the DocuSign API by obtaining necessary API keys and setting up OAuth 2.0 authentication.
Develop a function to integrate DocuSign API services into the platform that allows for generating lease agreement documents that can be sent for e-signing.
Create a user interface on the property manager dashboard for sending lease agreements directly to tenants for e-signature.
Implement a callback or webhook in the platform that receives notifications from DocuSign once a tenant has signed the document.
Develop functionality to store signed lease agreements securely on the platform, ensuring the storage is compliant with relevant data protection regulations.
Implement user authentication and authorization checks to ensure that only authorized property managers can send and view signed lease documents.
Create automated tests to verify the integration with DocuSign works correctly, focusing on authorization, document generation, sending, signing, and notification.
Develop a notification system in the platform that alerts property managers via email or on their dashboard when a tenant has signed the lease.
Ensure the user experience is seamless by providing clear instructions and feedback throughout the e-signing process on the platform.
Conduct a security assessment to ensure that all interactions with the DocuSign API and the storage of signed documents are secure.
Prepare documentation that covers how to use the e-signing feature, including troubleshooting common issues and explaining security measures in place.
Schedule a review and walkthrough with stakeholders to demonstrate the e-signing functionality and gather feedback for any needed improvements.

E002.Epic Description: Facilitate the creation, updating, renewal, and termination of lease agreements, including the use of templates, e-signing via DocuSign, and managing lease durations.
E002.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to be able to modify existing lease agreements so that I can update terms according to new agreements or corrections.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Functionality to select existing lease and make modifications.
Track changes made to the lease documents.
Re-submit for e-signing if significant changes are made.

Tasks.Description: Develop a user interface component that allows property managers to select an existing lease from a list of leases they manage. This component should provide a search and filter functionality to easily locate specific leases.

Implement a lease details view which property managers can access by selecting a lease. This view should display all current terms of the lease and provide editable fields for each term that can be modified.

Create a backend service to handle the retrieval and update of lease data. This service should support fetching the current details of a lease and updating those details in the database when modifications are submitted.

Design a version control system for lease documents that tracks all changes made to a lease. Each version should store a timestamp and the identity of the property manager who made the change. The system should allow property managers to review the history of changes.

Integrate the existing DocuSign API to support re-submitting updated lease documents for e-signing. This integration should handle sending the document to all relevant parties and tracking the signing status.
Ensure that a notification is sent to the property manager once the lease document is successfully re-submitted for e-signature, including status updates when each party signs the document.

Implement a confirmation dialogue that prompts the property manager to review all changes before final submission for re-signing. This dialogue should summarize the changes and require explicit confirmation to proceed.

Develop a feature to automatically update the lease status in the management system once all parties have signed the modified lease, ensuring that the lease terms in the system reflect the newly signed agreement.

E002.Epic Description: Facilitate the creation, updating, renewal, and termination of lease agreements, including the use of templates, e-signing via DocuSign, and managing lease durations.
E002.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to easily renew lease agreements so that I can retain tenants and ensure continuous occupancy.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Option to renew an existing lease with the same terms or updated conditions.
Automatic notification to tenants about upcoming lease expirations.
Quick re-signing process via DocuSign.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface option on the lease management dashboard for property managers to initiate lease renewals. This should include options to renew with the same terms or modify conditions.

Implement backend logic to handle the retrieval of existing lease agreements from the database, allowing property managers to select a lease for renewal and specify if the terms are to remain the same or are to be updated.
Create a notification system to alert tenants automatically about upcoming lease expirations. This should involve scheduling notifications that are sent out 60 days before the lease expires.
Integrate with the DocuSign API to facilitate the electronic signing of renewed lease agreements. This should support sending the lease document directly to tenants and tracking their signing status.

Develop a process that updates the lease status in the database once the renewed lease is signed via DocuSign. Ensure that the lease renewal confirmation is recorded and the lease expiration date is updated accordingly.

Implement a feature for automatic lease renewal reminders to be sent to property managers, alerting them to review and process pending renewals. These reminders should be configurable in the system settings.
Ensure the user interface for the lease renewal process is accessible and user-friendly on both desktop and mobile platforms, providing clear instructions and feedback throughout the process.
Test the end-to-end functionality of the lease renewal process, including the integration with DocuSign and the notification system, to ensure that all components work seamlessly and securely.
Document the new lease renewal process and update any relevant user help guides or FAQs to assist property managers in understanding and using the new features effectively.

E002.Epic Description: Facilitate the creation, updating, renewal, and termination of lease agreements, including the use of templates, e-signing via DocuSign, and managing lease durations.
E002.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to terminate lease agreements when necessary so that I can end the contract legally and make the unit available for new tenants.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Functionality to mark a lease as terminated with reasons.
Notification to tenant regarding lease termination.
Archiving of the terminated lease documentation.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a UI component for property managers to select and mark a lease as terminated. Include fields to enter termination reasons and confirm the action.
Develop the backend functionality to update the lease status in the database to 'terminated' and store the reasons provided by the property manager.

Create a function to send a notification to the tenant via email and possibly in-app notification systems, informing them about the lease termination and providing the reasons stated by the property manager.
Implement a feature to archive the terminated lease documentation. This should include storing the lease in a read-only format that can be accessed for historical reference.
Ensure compliance with data protection laws when archiving lease documentation, including secure storage and restricted access based on user roles.

E002.Epic Description: Facilitate the creation, updating, renewal, and termination of lease agreements, including the use of templates, e-signing via DocuSign, and managing lease durations.
E002.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to manage lease durations so that I can ensure contracts are up-to-date and comply with legal standards.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Track start and end dates of all leases.
Alerts for leases nearing their end date.
Options to extend or modify the lease duration directly from the dashboard.

Tasks.Description: Design a database schema to track start and end dates of all leases, ensuring fields for lease ID, property ID, tenant ID, start date, end date, and status are included.
Implement backend functionality to insert and update lease duration data in the database when a new lease is created or an existing lease is updated.
Develop a scheduled job that runs daily to check for leases nearing their end date based on the current date and the end date stored in the database.
Create an alert system in the property manager's dashboard that triggers notifications for leases nearing their end date, specifying which leases are affected.
Develop a user interface on the property manager's dashboard that allows for viewing all current leases along with their start and end dates.

Implement interactive options in the lease management dashboard allowing property managers to extend or modify lease durations, including UI elements for selecting new end dates and confirming changes.
Ensure backend support for processing lease duration modifications, including updating the database and re-calculating any affected schedules or payments.
Integrate the lease management system with email or SMS services to send automatic alerts to property managers about leases nearing their end date.
Conduct unit testing on the new backend functionalities to ensure data is correctly managed and that lease duration changes trigger the appropriate updates and alerts.
Perform integration testing to verify that the dashboard interacts correctly with the backend and that alerts and modifications function as intended across the system.

E003.Epic Description: Manage financial aspects including rent collection, security deposits, and service fee payments through Stripe, and provide detailed financial reports and analytics.
E003.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to integrate Stripe for processing rent payments so that I can securely collect monthly rent from tenants.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Ensure secure Stripe integration for rent transactions.
Ensure data encryption for sensitive information during transactions.
Provide confirmation of payment to both tenant and property manager via email and in-app notification.
Log all transactions in the system for future reference and reporting.

Tasks.Description: Research and select the appropriate Stripe API version for integration that supports the latest security features and is compatible with the application's technology stack.
Create a secure method to store Stripe API keys and secrets using environment variables to prevent hardcoding of sensitive information in the codebase.
Implement OAuth or a similar authentication mechanism to ensure secure communication between the application and Stripe's servers.
Develop a function to initiate Stripe payment processing that takes tenant payment details and the rent amount as input parameters and returns a transaction ID.
Implement data encryption for all sensitive user information during the transaction process, using industry-standard encryption protocols like AES-256.

Develop a confirmation email function that sends transaction details to both the tenant and property manager after a successful payment. The function should include parameters for recipient email, transaction date, amount, and status.
Create an in-app notification system that alerts the property manager and tenant in real-time upon successful completion of the transaction.
Design and implement a transaction logging system that records all payment transactions, including tenant details, amount, date, and status, in a secure and compliant manner.
Conduct thorough testing of the Stripe integration to validate security, accuracy of transactions, and the reliability of the email and in-app notification systems.
Prepare documentation for the property management platform team on how to manage the Stripe integration, including troubleshooting common issues and managing API key rotations.

E003.Epic Description: Manage financial aspects including rent collection, security deposits, and service fee payments through Stripe, and provide detailed financial reports and analytics.
E003.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to manage security deposits through Stripe so that I can securely hold and return deposits according to lease terms.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Allow collection of security deposits during lease signing.
Securely store deposit information in the platform.
Automate the return of deposits upon lease termination, minus any damages costs.
Provide detailed transaction records for both manager and tenant.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to handle security deposits, including fields for tenant ID, property ID, deposit amount, deposit status, and timestamp.
Develop a secure API endpoint for collection of security deposits. This endpoint must validate the property manager's credentials, tenant's information, and initiate a transaction using Stripe.
Implement a function in the backend to store deposit transaction information securely in the database upon successful processing of the payment through Stripe.
Create a function to calculate any damages costs from the security deposit based on inputs received from property inspection reports upon lease termination.
Develop an automated process that triggers the return of the remaining security deposit to the tenant through Stripe, upon lease termination and after damages costs deductions.
Design and implement a user interface on the property manager dashboard to allow managers to initiate security deposit collection during lease signing.
Implement a feature in the tenant's dashboard to view detailed transaction records of their security deposit, including any deductions for damages.
Ensure all data transmission involving security deposit transactions is encrypted and aligns with best security practices to protect both tenant and property manager information.
Conduct integration testing to verify that the security deposit collection, storage, deduction for damages, and return processes work seamlessly with Stripe and the database.
Prepare documentation for the property managers on how to manage security deposits through the platform, including steps on collection, deduction for damages, and returns process.

E003.Epic Description: Manage financial aspects including rent collection, security deposits, and service fee payments through Stripe, and provide detailed financial reports and analytics.
E003.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to automatically collect a service fee from subcontractors after each completed job so that I can maintain revenue from marketplace activities.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Automatically calculate and deduct a 3% service fee from subcontractor payments through Stripe.
Provide real-time updates of fee deductions to subcontractors.
Record all fee transactions for financial reporting.

Tasks.Description: Implement a Stripe integration module to handle payment processing, including secure API interactions for financial transactions.
Develop a service fee calculation function that automatically deducts 3% from subcontractor payments through Stripe after each completed job.
Create a real-time notification system that informs subcontractors about the deduction of the service fee through both in-app notifications and email alerts.
Design a database schema to record all financial transactions related to service fee deductions, ensuring fields include transaction id, subcontractor id, date, amount deducted, and purpose.
Set up a reporting interface for property managers to view and manage recorded fee transactions, with filtering capabilities by date, subcontractor, and amount.
Implement frontend components on the property manager dashboard to display real-time updates on fee deductions and transaction records.
Ensure compliance with financial regulations by implementing data encryption for all transactions and storing sensitive data securely.
Test the Stripe payment processing integration and fee deduction functionality thoroughly to ensure accuracy and reliability in all scenarios.
Document the technical implementation and usage instructions for the service fee management system in the project's technical documentation repository.

E003.Epic Description: Manage financial aspects including rent collection, security deposits, and service fee payments through Stripe, and provide detailed financial reports and analytics.
E003.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to generate financial reports and analytics so that I can monitor the financial performance of properties.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Generate monthly financial reports on rents, deposits, and service fees.
Offer analytics on payment trends and overdue accounts.
Enable downloading of reports in PDF format.
Ensure reports are accessible only by authorized staff.

Tasks.Description: Design the data model for storing financial transactions including rents, deposits, and service fees. Ensure the model supports detailed tracking and is capable of aggregating data necessary for reporting purposes.
Implement backend functionality to capture all financial transactions in real-time within the system. This includes integration points with Stripe for capturing rent payments and service fees.

Develop a monthly financial report generation feature that aggregates transaction data into a structured report covering rents, deposits, and service fees. Ensure the report includes analytics such as total collections, average transaction value, and identification of overdue accounts.

Create a secure reporting API that allows financial reports to be fetched programmatically. Ensure this API enforces authentication and authorization to make sure that reports are accessible only by authorized staff.
Implement a front-end feature for users to view financial reports and analytics through the platform's dashboard. Include filtering options to customize the report by date range or property.

Develop functionality for users to download financial reports in PDF format directly from the platform. This should generate a downloadable PDF that captures all the relevant financial data displayed on the page.

Set up role-based access controls within the platform to ensure that financial reports and analytics are only accessible by authorized personnel. Include mechanisms to audit access to sensitive financial data.

E003.Epic Description: Manage financial aspects including rent collection, security deposits, and service fee payments through Stripe, and provide detailed financial reports and analytics.
E003.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want the system to automatically notify tenants of late payments so that I can ensure timely rent collection.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Send automatic email and in-app notifications to tenants within one day of missed payment deadline.
Provide property managers the ability to customize the notification message.
Log all notifications sent for record-keeping and follow-up.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to track rent payment deadlines and payment statuses for each tenant.
Develop a scheduled job that runs daily to check for missed payment deadlines based on the stored rent payment deadlines in the database.
Implement a notification system that triggers email and in-app notifications to tenants whose payment deadlines have passed without a recorded payment.
Create an interface for property managers to customize the late payment notification message, including placeholders for tenant name, due amount, and due date.
Integrate the customized messages into the notification system so that the content of the notifications can be dynamically generated based on property manager preferences and tenant-specific details.
Develop functionality to log details of all notifications sent, including recipient, time, and notification content, in a database for audit and follow-up purposes.
Implement security measures to ensure that the notification system handles tenant data sensitively and complies with data protection regulations.

Test the end-to-end functionality of the late payment notification system, including the accuracy of payment status checks, the appropriateness of the notification messages, and the reliability of delivery methods (email and in-app).
Prepare detailed documentation on the setup and operation of the late payment notification system for both technical maintenance and user training purposes.

E004.Epic Description: Handle maintenance and repair requests from tenants, delegate tasks to subcontractors, and manage status updates from request to completion.
E004.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to be able to securely log in to the platform so that I can access my dashboard and manage maintenance requests.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Secure login page using registered credentials
Session management with timeout for security
Functionality for 'Forgot Password' to recover access

Tasks.Description: Develop a secure login page interface for Property Managers. Include fields for username and password, and a login button.
Implement backend authentication logic to validate Property Manager credentials against the database securely using hashing and salting techniques.
Create session management functionality to establish a secure session upon successful login. Include methods to handle session timeout after a defined period of inactivity.

Design and implement a 'Forgot Password' feature. This should include a secure process to verify user identity and allow them to reset their password through a link sent to their registered email address.
Ensure the login system logs all successful and unsuccessful login attempts, including IP address and timestamp, to support potential security audit processes.
Incorporate multi-factor authentication (MFA) as an additional security layer. Allow Property Managers to set up MFA during their first login or through their account settings.
Implement automated tests to verify the security of the login process, including checks for SQL injection and cross-site scripting vulnerabilities.
Set up and configure SSL/TLS on the server to ensure all data transmitted during the login process is encrypted.
Develop a user-friendly interface for the session timeout feature, providing users with a warning message and the option to extend their session before automatic logout.
Create a comprehensive user guide and FAQs for Property Managers to help them understand how to handle login issues, manage their sessions, and securely reset their passwords.

E004.Epic Description: Handle maintenance and repair requests from tenants, delegate tasks to subcontractors, and manage status updates from request to completion.
E004.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to view a list of all maintenance and repair requests submitted by tenants so that I can track and prioritize tasks effectively.
Story Acceptance Criteria: List all maintenance requests in an organized dashboard
Filter requests by status (Pending, Accepted, Rejected, and Completed)
Option to view detailed descriptions and attached documents or images

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to store maintenance and repair requests. Include fields for request ID, tenant ID, description, status (Pending, Accepted, Rejected, Completed), priority, submission date, and any attachments.
Develop a backend API endpoint to retrieve maintenance and repair requests from the database. The endpoint should support filtering by status and sorting by priority and submission date.
Create authentication and authorization mechanisms to ensure that only authenticated property managers can access the maintenance request data.
Implement the frontend functionality to display the list of maintenance and repair requests in an organized dashboard. Utilize a table or grid layout to present the data clearly.
Develop frontend components to allow property managers to filter the list of maintenance requests by status (Pending, Accepted, Rejected, Completed).

Integrate a feature on the frontend for property managers to view detailed descriptions of each maintenance request. This should include modal or expandable sections that can show more details and any attached documents or images.
Ensure responsive design principles are applied so that the maintenance request dashboard is accessible and functional across different devices and screen sizes.
Implement security measures such as data validation both on the client side and server side to protect against SQL injection and other common security threats.
Set up unit tests for the backend API to validate filtering, sorting, and data retrieval functionalities.
Conduct usability testing with a focus group of property managers to gather feedback on the dashboard interface and make adjustments based on their input.

E004.Epic Description: Handle maintenance and repair requests from tenants, delegate tasks to subcontractors, and manage status updates from request to completion.
E004.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to delegate repair tasks to available subcontractors so that maintenance issues are resolved promptly.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Function to assign tasks to subcontractors directly from the maintenance request list
Notification system to alert subcontractors of new assignments
Subcontractors can accept or reject tasks

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to store maintenance requests, including fields for request ID, property ID, description, status, and assigned subcontractor ID.
Develop a backend functionality to list maintenance requests from the database that are unassigned or require reassignment, making the data available for property managers on the platform.
Create a dropdown or selection interface on the property manager's dashboard where they can view and select subcontractors based on availability and skill set, linked to the maintenance requests.

Implement a function in the backend that allows property managers to assign or reassign maintenance tasks to subcontractors by updating the assigned subcontractor ID and status in the maintenance request record.
Develop a notification system that automatically sends alerts to subcontractors via email and in-app notifications when they are assigned to a new maintenance task.
Create an API endpoint to handle acceptance or rejection of maintenance tasks by subcontractors, which updates the task status in the database based on the subcontractor's response.

Implement a user interface on the subcontractor's dashboard for viewing new tasks assigned to them, including details like the property location, task description, and an option to accept or reject the task.

Set up a real-time update system that reflects changes in the assignment status on the property manager’s dashboard, enabling them to track which tasks have been accepted or rejected by subcontractors.

E004.Epic Description: Handle maintenance and repair requests from tenants, delegate tasks to subcontractors, and manage status updates from request to completion.
E004.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to update and track the status of each maintenance task so that I can keep tenants informed and ensure timely resolution of issues.

Automated notifications to tenants upon status updates
Log and track changes in the maintenance request dashboard

Tasks.Description: Create a database schema to support maintenance task status tracking, including fields for task ID, tenant ID, status, last updated timestamp, and any relevant notes or changes.

Develop a backend API endpoint to update the status of a maintenance task. This endpoint should accept parameters like task ID and new status, and it should handle validations to ensure the status is one of the predefined states (Pending, In Progress, Completed).

Implement logic in the backend to log changes whenever a task's status is updated. This should include storing the old status, new status, timestamp of change, and user (property manager) making the change.

Create automated notifications that trigger to tenants via email and in-app notifications when the status of their maintenance task is updated. This involves integrating with the email service and in-app notification system.

Develop a frontend feature on the property manager's dashboard to allow them to update and track maintenance tasks. This should include a user-friendly interface displaying tasks, their current status, and options to update status.

Ensure that the task status update functionality on the frontend properly calls the backend API endpoint and handles responses, displaying appropriate success or error messages based on the outcome of the status update.
Implement front-end components to visually represent the status of maintenance tasks in the maintenance request dashboard. This could include colored labels or progress bars.
Conduct integration testing to ensure that the status updates made by property managers correctly trigger notifications and are logged in the system as per the requirements.
Setup security measures to ensure that only authorized property managers can update the status of maintenance tasks, and to secure the transmission and storage of data related to these tasks.

E004.Epic Description: Handle maintenance and repair requests from tenants, delegate tasks to subcontractors, and manage status updates from request to completion.
E004.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to review completed work by subcontractors to ensure quality before marking tasks as completed.

Approve or request rework based on satisfaction
Finalize payment and close tasks upon approval

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface for property managers to review work reports and uploaded proof of work, such as photos and documents. This interface should include functionality to view and inspect the details provided by subcontractors.

Develop a backend function to fetch and display work reports and proof of work from the database. This function should handle the retrieval of photos, documents, and textual reports associated with completed tasks.

Create a review system within the platform that allows property managers to approve or request rework. This system should include options to approve the work as satisfactory or to provide feedback and request additional work if the initial results are unsatisfactory.

Ensure that all changes made by property managers, such as approvals or requests for rework, are logged in the system for accountability and tracking purposes. This should include who made the change, what change was made, and the date/time of the change.

Set up notification mechanisms to alert subcontractors when their submitted work has been reviewed. Notifications should specify whether the work was approved or if rework is required, including any feedback from the property manager.

Conduct thorough testing of the review and approval features to ensure they work correctly across different devices and meet all functional requirements. This includes testing the user interface, backend functions, payment integration, and notifications.

Provide comprehensive documentation on how property managers can use the new features for reviewing, approving, and finalizing tasks. This documentation should be accessible within the platform through a help section.

E004.Epic Description: Handle maintenance and repair requests from tenants, delegate tasks to subcontractors, and manage status updates from request to completion.

Generate invoices and receipts for bookkeeping purposes

Tasks.Description: Implement Stripe API integration for processing direct payments to subcontractors. This includes setting up secure authentication with Stripe, configuring payment endpoints, and ensuring compliance with financial data protection standards.

Develop a payment tracking system within the platform dashboard. This should include features to record each transaction detail such as payment amount, date, recipient subcontractor, and status (pending, completed, failed).

Create functionality to generate digital invoices for each transaction with subcontractors. Develop a system to generate and manage digital receipts for payments made to subcontractors. Receipts should capture transaction details and be accessible to both the property manager and subcontractor for download and printing.

Ensure all financial transactions and generated documents (invoices and receipts) are logged and stored securely within the platform. Implement access controls to restrict data visibility based on user roles (property manager, subcontractor).
Implement backend services for real-time updates of payment statuses on the platform's dashboard, allowing property managers to track the progress and confirmation of each transaction.
Set up automated notifications to alert property managers and subcontractors about transaction status changes such as payment initiation, completion, or failure due to processing errors.

E004.Epic Description: Handle maintenance and repair requests from tenants, delegate tasks to subcontractors, and manage status updates from request to completion.

Restrict tenant's access to other tenants' and subcontractors' personal data
Audit trails for monitoring access and activities within the platform

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a role-based access control system. Define roles such as Property Manager, Tenant, and Subcontractor, specifying the specific permissions and access each role has within the platform.
Develop functionality to enforce access restrictions. Ensure that tenants can only view or modify their own personal data and have no access to other tenants' or subcontractors' information.

Create an audit logging system that records all access and actions taken by users within the platform. This should include user identification, time of action, and the nature of the accessed or modified data.

Implement backend security measures that enforce the role-based access control settings, preventing unauthorized access or modification of protected information by checking user credentials and roles on each action.
Develop a secure and encrypted database architecture that ensures sensitive data is stored securely and provides robust defenses against potential data breaches.
Establish a regular review and update protocol for the access control configurations to adapt to new security challenges and requirements as the platform evolves.
Integrate the role-based access control system with existing user authentication mechanisms to streamline security processes across the platform.
Conduct comprehensive testing of the role-based access control system, including penetration testing and scenario-based testing to validate the enforcement and effectiveness of security policies.
Provide training and documentation for the platform administrators on managing access controls, understanding audit logs, and adhering to best security practices.
Implement user interfaces for property managers to easily review and manage access permissions for their team, with options to adjust roles as needed directly from the platform dashboard.

Prepare documentation for property managers on how to use the system to manage tenant profiles, focusing on security practices and compliance aspects.

Deploy a logging system to monitor and record all attempts to access restricted areas of the platform by unauthorized roles. This will help in auditing and identifying potential security breaches or misconfigurations in the access control setup.

E007.Story Description: As a Property Manager, I want to recover my password if I forget it, so that I can regain access to my account without compromising security.

Upon request, prompt the user to enter their registered email address.
Send a password reset link to the specified email only if it is associated with an existing account.
Ensure the reset link is time-bound (e.g., valid for 1 hour).
Allow the user to set a new password after verifying through the link.
Confirm password reset via email after the process is successfully completed.

Tasks.Description: Implement a 'Forgot Password' link on the login page that leads to a password recovery form.
Create a password recovery form that prompts the user to enter their registered email address.
Develop backend logic to validate the entered email address against existing accounts in the database.
If the email address exists, generate a time-limited password reset link and send it to the user's registered email.
Ensure the password reset link is valid only for a limited time period, such as 1 hour, and display this information to the user.
Create a password reset page accessible via the password reset link, allowing the user to enter a new password.
Implement password strength validation to ensure the new password meets security criteria.
Update the user's password in the database upon successful validation and submission of the new password.
Send a confirmation email to the user once the password reset process is successfully completed.

E007.Epic Description: Define and manage access permissions across different functionalities of the platform to secure sensitive information and operations.

Ensure that any updates or deletions to property listings are immediately reflected on the platform without requiring a page refresh or re-login.
Create functionality for bulk updates and deletions to manage multiple property listings simultaneously. Include checkboxes for selection and apply changes with a single action.

Ability to assign specific properties to the secondary manager's account.
Interface for managing permissions specific to property-related tasks.
Successful login and logout functionality for secondary managers.
Email notification sent to secondary managers upon account creation.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for creating new secondary property manager accounts. Include fields for username, email, and password.

UI for selecting and modifying permissions.

Tasks.Description: Design a password reset feature for secondary property managers. This includes creating a user interface on the dashboard where secondary property managers can enter their registered email to request a password reset.

Conduct a security audit to verify that the encryption implementations meet the required standards. This includes reviewing configuration, testing for vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance with Canadian data protection laws.

Develop a notification system that alerts users via email or in-app notifications whenever there are changes to the data usage policies or their consent preferences.
Ensure that the consent management feature complies with Canadian data protection laws by consulting with legal experts to verify the implementation meets all legal requirements.

Implement server-side functionality to automatically write to the access logs any time user data is accessed, ensuring all criteria such as identity, timestamp, and access type are logged.
Ensure all access logs are stored in a secure and encrypted format to prevent unauthorized access and tampering. Use industry-standard encryption protocols.

Develop an API endpoint that allows authorized personnel to retrieve access logs based on specific queries (e.g., by date, by accessor, by type of access).
