Implement input fields on the registration form for subcontractor's business details including business name, type, and services offered.
Develop a backend API to handle the submission of the registration form, ensuring data is received and stored securely in the database.
Integrate an OTP (One Time Password) service to verify the phone number provided by the subcontractor during the registration process.
Implement functionality in the backend to generate an activation link and send it to the subcontractor’s email address upon successful registration.
Create a secure method for subcontractors to set and store their password during the registration process, using best practices for password hashing and salting.
Develop a user interface for password setting and confirmation as part of the registration process.
Ensure the registration system has validation checks for all input fields to prevent SQL injection and other common security threats.
Set up email templates for account activation and OTP verification that are clear and provide straightforward instructions for subcontractors.
Implement a system to monitor and log registration attempts and alert administrators of any suspicious activity during the registration process.

E001.Epic Description: Provide subcontractors with access to a job marketplace where they can find and apply for work offerings related to property maintenance and repairs.
E001.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to be able to log into the platform using my registered credentials, so that I can access my profile and job marketplace.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Subcontractor can log in using email and password.
Subcontractor can request a password reset link if they forget their password.
The system should provide ‘Remember Me’ functionality to facilitate easier logins on return visits.

Tasks.Description: Implement a login function that accepts email and password as inputs and checks these credentials against the database. If the credentials are valid, grant access to the user's profile and job marketplace.

Design a password reset feature that allows subcontractors to request a reset link. This involves capturing the subcontractor's registered email, sending a secure link to that email, and allowing the subcontractor to set a new password using the link.

Create a 'Remember Me' feature that allows the system to store the subcontractor's login credentials securely on their device. Implement this with a checkbox on the login page, which if checked, will keep the user logged in for a set period or until they explicitly log out.
Set up secure handling of passwords and credentials using hashing and encryption techniques to protect subcontractor information both at rest and in transit.
Develop input validation for the email and password fields to ensure data conforms to expected formats and security standards.

Implement backend logic to handle session management, ensuring that sessions are maintained when 'Remember Me' is active, and properly terminated after a predefined period of inactivity or when the user logs out.
Integrate frontend and backend for the login system, ensuring that the user interface is intuitive and accessible, and that it communicates effectively with the server for authentication processes.
Conduct thorough testing of the login, password reset, and 'Remember Me' functionalities across different devices and browsers to ensure reliability and security.
Prepare user documentation and help resources for subcontractors on how to use the login system, including how to reset their password and the benefits of the 'Remember Me' functionality.
Implement monitoring and logging of login attempts and password reset requests to detect and respond to potential security threats or breaches.

E001.Epic Description: Provide subcontractors with access to a job marketplace where they can find and apply for work offerings related to property maintenance and repairs.
E001.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to view a list of available jobs in my set radius/working area, so that I can apply for jobs that match my skills and preferences.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Job listings must be displayed with essential details like location, job description, and estimated pay.
Subcontractor can filter job listings by categories such as electrical, plumbing, etc.
Subcontractor can view details of a job by selecting it from the list.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to store job listings ensuring fields for location, job description, and estimated pay are included.
Create a backend API to fetch job listings from the database. The API should support basic retrieval of all job listings with essential details.

Develop filtering functionality in the backend API to allow subcontractors to filter job listings by job categories such as electrical, plumbing, etc. This involves modifying the existing API to accept filter parameters and return filtered results.

Implement a user interface on the subcontractor's portal for displaying job listings. The interface should include elements like a list view to show job details including location, description, and pay.

Add interactive filter options in the user interface allowing subcontractors to select job categories for filtering the job listings. This interface should dynamically update the list of jobs displayed based on the selected filters.
Create a detailed view for each job listing that can be accessed by selecting a job from the list. This view should display comprehensive details of the job.
Ensure the system supports responsive design so that subcontractors can view job listings effectively across different devices including mobiles, tablets, and desktops.
Integrate the front-end components with the backend API ensuring that data fetched from the API is properly displayed in the user interface, including the use of filters.
Perform unit testing on the backend API to ensure that job listings are fetched and filtered correctly according to the specified parameters.
Conduct integration testing to verify that the frontend and backend work seamlessly together, especially the filters and detailed job views.
Prepare user documentation that includes instructions on how to navigate the job listings page, use filters, and access job details.

E001.Epic Description: Provide subcontractors with access to a job marketplace where they can find and apply for work offerings related to property maintenance and repairs.
E001.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to be able to apply for jobs by submitting a proposal, so that property managers can consider me for the work.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Subcontractor can submit a proposal including a cover letter, estimated cost, and timeframe.
Subcontractor can attach supporting documents to their proposal.
Subcontractor receives confirmation upon successful submission of a job application.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface form for subcontractors to submit a job proposal. The form should include fields for a cover letter, estimated cost, and timeframe.
Implement functionality for subcontractors to attach supporting documents to their job proposal. This should include support for multiple file formats such as PDF, DOCX, and images.
Develop backend API endpoints to handle the storage of the submitted job proposals and attached documents. Ensure data is securely stored and complies with data protection regulations.
Create a submission confirmation feature that triggers an email and in-app notification to the subcontractor confirming the successful submission of their job proposal.
Integrate the job proposal submission form with existing user authentication mechanisms to ensure that only registered subcontractors can submit proposals.
Conduct unit and integration testing of the job proposal submission feature to ensure all components (form submission, file attachment, confirmation notifications) work seamlessly.
Set up a database schema for storing job proposals, including fields for cover letter, estimated cost, timeframe, and references to attached documents.
Implement security measures for file uploads to prevent the upload of malicious files, including virus scanning and validation of file types and sizes.
Prepare user documentation and tooltips within the application to assist subcontractors in using the job proposal submission feature effectively.
Deploy the job proposal submission feature to the staging environment for testing purposes and gather feedback from a select group of subcontractors.

E001.Epic Description: Provide subcontractors with access to a job marketplace where they can find and apply for work offerings related to property maintenance and repairs.
E001.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to receive notifications about job application statuses and other relevant updates, so that I am informed about opportunities and changes in real time.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Subcontractor receives an email and in-app notification when their job application is accepted or rejected.
Subcontractor receives alerts for new jobs posted within their service area.

Tasks.Description: Implement an email notification service to send emails to subcontractors when their job applications are accepted or rejected. Inputs include the subcontractor's email address and the status of the application. Outputs include a confirmation of the email sent.

Develop an in-app notification system to alert subcontractors about the status of their job applications. Inputs include the subcontractor's user ID and the application status. Outputs include displaying the notification in the subcontractor's account interface.

Create functionality to notify subcontractors of new job postings within their specified service areas. Inputs include job details and the subcontractor’s service area preferences. Outputs include sending targeted alerts via email and in-app notifications.

Set up a database schema to store notification preferences and job application statuses for each subcontractor. Inputs include subcontractor's preferences and job application details. Outputs include stored data that can be queried for sending notifications.

Integrate a job posting listener that triggers notifications based on new job postings that match subcontractor preferences. Inputs include new job postings and subcontractor service area settings. Outputs include the trigger of notification processes.

Implement a service for managing subscription to job alerts, allowing subcontractors to set and modify their service area preferences. Inputs include subcontractor IDs and their new preferences. Outputs include updated preferences in the database.

Develop a secure authentication mechanism for subcontractors to log in to the notification system, ensuring that notifications are received and accessed by the intended recipients only. Inputs include login credentials. Outputs include authentication status and access to the notification system.

E001.Epic Description: Provide subcontractors with access to a job marketplace where they can find and apply for work offerings related to property maintenance and repairs.
E001.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to manage my profile and the services I offer, so that potential clients can view up-to-date information about my business.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Subcontractor can update personal and business information in their profile.
Subcontractor can add or remove services they provide.
Changes must be saved and reflected immediately on the platform.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface (UI) for the subcontractor profile management section, including forms for updating personal and business information, and adding or removing services.
Develop front-end functionality using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to allow subcontractors to input and modify their personal and business information in the profile management section.
Implement form validation logic in the front-end to ensure all user inputs are in the correct format and required fields are not left empty.
Create RESTful API endpoints to handle POST and PUT requests for updating subcontractor profile information including personal details, business information, and services offered.
Develop back-end logic to check existing entries and update them in the database or add new entries when subcontractors modify their profile or service offerings.
Ensure real-time updating of subcontractor's profile by setting up efficient data binding between the user interface and the database using a framework like Angular or React.
Implement functionality to allow subcontractors to add new services to their profile, including an interface element for inputting service details and a method for saving this to the database.
Develop functionality for subcontractors to remove existing services from their profile, which includes updating the database to reflect these changes immediately.
Ensure all changes made by subcontractors in their profile are immediately visible on the platform by testing the integration between the front-end and back-end systems.
Conduct thorough testing including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance tests to ensure all functionalities meet the acceptance criteria and work seamlessly.
Prepare documentation for the profile management feature that includes instructions on how to update profiles, add or remove services, and troubleshooting common issues.

E001.Epic Description: Provide subcontractors with access to a job marketplace where they can find and apply for work offerings related to property maintenance and repairs.
E001.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to manage my payment details securely on the platform, so that I can receive payments directly to my account for completed jobs.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Subcontractor can add or update their bank information.
The platform must comply with Canadian law for data protection.
Subcontractor can remove existing bank details.

Tasks.Description: Design a secure form interface for subcontractors to add and update their bank information, including fields for bank name, account number, and routing number.
Implement backend API services to handle the creation and updating of bank details, ensuring that all data sent to and from the server is encrypted according to industry standards.
Integrate form validation to check the correctness and completeness of the input bank information before submission to prevent errors and ensure data integrity.
Develop a secure method for subcontractors to remove their bank details, involving confirmation steps to prevent accidental deletions.
Ensure compliance with Canadian data protection laws by conducting a review of the platform's data handling and storage practices, adjusting them as necessary to meet legal standards.
Create a user-friendly dashboard interface for subcontractors to view, add, or update their payment details, with clear navigational elements and instructions.
Implement system logging and monitoring for all activities related to payment details management to ensure traceability and security compliance.
Set up automated tests to verify the security and functionality of the payment details management features, including form submission and data encryption processes.
Deploy a review mechanism for any changes made to subcontractors’ bank details to ensure accuracy and prevent unauthorized modifications.
Prepare documentation and user guides explaining how subcontractors can manage their payment details securely on the platform, emphasizing aspects related to compliance with Canadian law.

E002.Epic Description: Enable subcontractors to apply for jobs, manage their applications, and view the status of their bids, facilitating an organized approach to securing contracts.
E002.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to create and submit job applications so that I can apply for specific job postings relevant to my skills.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Subcontractor can access a job application form from their dashboard.
Form includes fields for job specifics, expected compensation, and project duration.
Subcontractor can attach relevant documents or images.
Application can be saved as a draft before submitting.
Confirmation message appears after successful submission.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface component on the subcontractor's dashboard that provides access to the job application form.
Develop a web form that includes fields for job specifics such as job title, location, and job description, expected compensation in numerical format, and project duration with date pickers.

Implement a feature in the form that allows subcontractors to attach documents or images. Supported formats should include PDF, DOCX, JPG, and PNG. Ensure there's a file size limit and provide feedback to users if the limit is exceeded.
Create functionality for saving the job application form as a draft. This should involve storing the form's state in the database associated with the subcontractor's user ID.
Develop the back-end logic to handle form submission, including validation of the form data to ensure all required fields are filled and correctly formatted.
Implement a confirmation message that appears upon successful submission of the job application. This message should confirm receipt and provide any next steps or additional information.
Ensure that the job application form and its functionalities are accessible and responsive on various devices including desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
Perform integration testing to ensure that the new job application form interfaces correctly with existing dashboard functionalities and that data flows correctly to and from the backend systems.
Conduct user acceptance testing with a group of subcontractors to gather feedback on the usability of the job application form and make necessary adjustments based on the feedback.
Deploy the updated job application functionality to the live environment after successful testing and review. Monitor the system for any issues post-deployment.

E002.Epic Description: Enable subcontractors to apply for jobs, manage their applications, and view the status of their bids, facilitating an organized approach to securing contracts.
E002.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to view, track, and manage my job applications to monitor the status of my bids and make necessary updates.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Subcontractor can view a list of all job applications submitted.
Each application in the list shows its current status (pending, accepted, rejected).
Subcontractor can edit and update their applications until they are reviewed.
Subcontractor can withdraw their application if it has not been accepted yet.

Tasks.Description: Design database schema to store job applications with fields including application ID, subcontractor ID, job ID, application status (pending, accepted, rejected), submission date, and any additional data required for the application.
Implement API endpoint to fetch job applications for a logged-in subcontractor, which returns a list of applications with their respective details and current status.

Create a user interface component on the subcontractor dashboard to display the list of job applications. This component should include columns for job details, submitted date, and current status. Ensure it is accessible and complies with UI/UX best practices.
Develop functionality on the backend to allow subcontractors to edit and update their job applications. Ensure that only applications that have not been reviewed (pending status) can be edited.
Create UI controls (edit buttons and forms) to enable subcontractors to modify their pending job applications directly from the list view on their dashboard.
Implement API endpoint to handle the withdrawal of job applications by subcontractors, ensuring that only applications in a 'pending' state can be withdrawn.
Add a 'Withdraw' button next to each eligible job application on the subcontractor’s dashboard, allowing them to easily withdraw their application if it has not yet been accepted.
Ensure all new endpoints are secured and only accessible by the subcontractor who owns the job applications, incorporating appropriate authentication and authorization checks.
Conduct integration testing to verify that the job application management functionalities (view, edit, update, withdraw) work seamlessly together and data integrity is maintained across the platform.
Deploy updates to the staging environment and conduct end-to-end testing with realistic data to ensure that the job application management system works as expected under typical usage scenarios.
Prepare documentation for the new job application management features, including user guides for subcontractors and technical documentation for ongoing support and future development.

E002.Epic Description: Enable subcontractors to apply for jobs, manage their applications, and view the status of their bids, facilitating an organized approach to securing contracts.
E002.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to receive notifications regarding the status of my job applications so that I am informed of any updates or changes.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Notifications for job application status updates (accepted, rejected, feedback) are automatically sent to the subcontractor.
Subcontractor can view notifications in a dedicated section.
Email notifications are sent in addition to in-platform notifications.

Tasks.Description: Design the database schema to store notification data, including fields for notification type (accepted, rejected, feedback), status, associated job application ID, timestamp, and subcontractor ID.

Implement a notification service backend that triggers notifications based on job application status changes. This service should handle the creation and storage of notification records in the database.
Develop an API endpoint to fetch notifications for a subcontractor. This endpoint must support pagination and filtering by notification type.

Create a dedicated notification section in the subcontractor's dashboard on the frontend. This section will retrieve and display notifications from the backend API, showing details such as notification type, message, and timestamp.
Implement email notification functionality using a third-party service like SendGrid or AWS SES to send emails to subcontractors whenever a job application status is updated.

Set up a scheduled task or webhook in the job application management system to call the notification service when a job application's status is updated, ensuring that the subcontractor receives real-time updates.
Design and implement a user interface for managing notification preferences, allowing subcontractors to opt-in or opt-out of receiving email notifications in addition to in-platform notifications.
Conduct integration testing to ensure that the notification system works seamlessly across the database, backend, and frontend components, and that email notifications are sent correctly.
Perform security checks to ensure that subcontractors only access their own notifications, implementing appropriate authentication and authorization controls.
Prepare documentation for the notification system, detailing the API usage, frontend component interactions, and how to manage notification preferences.

E002.Epic Description: Enable subcontractors to apply for jobs, manage their applications, and view the status of their bids, facilitating an organized approach to securing contracts.
E002.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to access a history of all my job applications to review past applications and learn from feedback.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Subcontractor can access a historical view of all job applications.
History includes details of the job, application status, and feedback from employers.
Filter and search functionality to find specific applications by date, job title, or status.

Tasks.Description: Design a database schema to store job applications with attributes including job ID, subcontractor ID, job title, application status, feedback from employers, and application date.
Implement backend API endpoint to fetch all job applications for a subcontractor, which includes job details, application status, and employer feedback.
Create functionality in the backend to apply filter and search queries on the job applications data based on date, job title, or status.
Develop a user interface component for the subcontractor dashboard to display a historical view of all job applications.
Integrate the front-end components with the backend API to retrieve and display the job applications data dynamically.
Implement user interface elements for filtering and searching the job application history based on provided criteria like date, job title, or status.
Ensure proper input validation on the filter and search functionalities to prevent SQL injection and ensure data integrity.
Write unit tests for the backend API to ensure it handles retrieving, filtering, and searching job applications correctly.
Conduct usability testing with a focus group of subcontractors to gather feedback on the ease of use and functionality of the job application history feature.
Review and ensure compliance with data protection regulations for handling and displaying personal and job application data.

E002.Epic Description: Enable subcontractors to apply for jobs, manage their applications, and view the status of their bids, facilitating an organized approach to securing contracts.
E002.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to receive feedback on my rejected applications so that I can improve future applications.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Feedback is provided for each rejected application, visible in the application details.
Feedback section includes comments from the employer on why the application was rejected.
Subcontractor can request further clarification on feedback via a messaging feature.

Tasks.Description: Create a database schema for storing feedback on job applications. This schema should include fields for application ID, feedback text, rejection reasons, and a timestamp.

Develop an API endpoint to fetch feedback for a rejected application. The endpoint should retrieve feedback details based on the application ID and ensure that only the subcontractor who owns the application can access the feedback.
Implement a user interface component on the subcontractor's dashboard to display feedback for each rejected application. This component should include the feedback text and rejection reasons.

Create a feature in the feedback display component that allows subcontractors to send a request for further clarification on the feedback received. This should include a form to submit the request and an integration to notify the employer.
Set up notifications for employers when a subcontractor requests further clarification on feedback. This should include both an email and in-app notification system.
Develop a system to manage responses from employers regarding clarification requests. This should include storing the responses in the database and making them accessible via an API.
Update the subcontractor dashboard to include a section for viewing responses to their clarification requests on rejected applications. Ensure this section is only visible for relevant requests.
Conduct integration testing to ensure that the feedback and clarification request features interact correctly with existing job application and authentication systems.
Implement security measures to ensure that feedback details and clarification requests are securely stored and transmitted. This should include data encryption and secure API access controls.
Prepare user documentation that explains how to view feedback on rejected applications and request further clarification. Include screenshots and step-by-step instructions.

E002.Epic Description: Enable subcontractors to apply for jobs, manage their applications, and view the status of their bids, facilitating an organized approach to securing contracts.
E002.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to securely log into the platform and manage my account settings to ensure my personal and application data is protected.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Secure login process with email and password.
Forgot password and password reset functionalities.
Profile management features to update personal details, credentials, and communication preferences.

Tasks.Description: Design a secure login form interface that includes fields for email and password. Include both frontend and backend validations to ensure data integrity.
Implement authentication logic using a secure method such as OAuth 2.0 or JWT to handle and validate the login credentials provided by subcontractors.

Develop a forgot password feature that allows subcontractors to request a password reset link. This includes generating a secure, time-limited token that is emailed to the user’s registered email address.

Create a password reset page that subcontractors can access via the link sent to their email. The page should allow them to input a new password, securely hash the password, and update the user's record in the database.

Design and implement a profile management interface in the subcontractor's dashboard where personal details and credentials can be updated. This interface should include form fields for common details such as name, phone number, and professional credentials.
Build backend APIs to handle the fetching, updating, and storing of profile data. Ensure all data transmissions are secured through HTTPS and sensitive data is hashed or encrypted as appropriate.
Implement input validation on both the client and server sides to prevent SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), and other common security vulnerabilities during profile updates.
Create unit and integration tests to verify that the login process, password reset functionality, and profile management operations work as expected and handle errors gracefully.
Configure and secure all endpoints related to authentication and profile management to ensure that only authenticated users can access and modify their personal data.

E003.Epic Description: Facilitate effective communication between subcontractors, property managers, and tenants through an integrated chat system to discuss job details and coordinate schedules.
E003.Story Description: As a subcontractor, I want to be able to log in securely to the chat system so that I can access my messages and communicate with property managers and tenants.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Login page is accessible from the main website.
Subcontractors can log in using their registered email and password.
System validates credentials and denies access with incorrect login details.
Redirect to the main communication dashboard upon successful login.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a login page that is directly accessible from the main website's homepage, ensuring it includes fields for entering an email and a password.
Develop backend authentication logic to verify subcontractor login credentials using their registered email and password. Include security measures such as hashing and salting passwords.
Create a validation system that checks for common errors in email and password input, such as incorrect format or empty fields, and display appropriate error messages.
Configure the system to block access if the login credentials do not match the stored details and provide an error message to the user.
Upon successful login validation, implement a session management system to create a session token and redirect users to the main communication dashboard.
Ensure the login page and authentication process adhere to security best practices, such as HTTPS for data transmission and proper handling of authentication tokens.

E003.Epic Description: Facilitate effective communication between subcontractors, property managers, and tenants through an integrated chat system to discuss job details and coordinate schedules.
E003.Story Description: As a subcontractor, I want to recover my password via email if I forget it so that I can regain access to the chat system.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Password recovery option is available on the login page.
Subcontractors can enter their registered email to receive a password reset link.
Subcontractors can reset their password using the link sent to their email.
Subcontractors can log in with the new password after resetting.

Tasks.Description: Design a password recovery interface on the login page with an option for subcontractors to initiate password recovery.
Implement backend service to verify entered email against stored subcontractor emails and generate a password reset link.
Configure an email service to dispatch the password reset link to the subcontractor's registered email address.
Develop a secure password reset page that subcontractors can access via the received link to reset their password.
Ensure the password reset page allows subcontractors to enter and confirm a new password, validating it against security policies (minimum length, complexity).
Update the subcontractor's password in the database with the newly set password once successfully changed.
Implement login functionality that allows subcontractors to test the new password ensuring the new credentials are active.
Set up secure logging and error handling mechanisms for the password recovery and reset process to handle potential issues like invalid email entries or system errors.

E003.Epic Description: Facilitate effective communication between subcontractors, property managers, and tenants through an integrated chat system to discuss job details and coordinate schedules.
E003.Story Description: As a subcontractor, I want to send direct messages to property managers and tenants so that I can discuss job details and respond to queries.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Ability to select a recipient from a list of contacts which includes property managers and tenants.
Text box to type messages and a send button.
Sent messages are visible in the chat window.
Recipients receive messages in real-time.

Tasks.Description: Design the database schema to include tables for Messages, Users, and Contacts, ensuring relationships are properly set to link subcontractors, property managers, and tenants.
Implement backend API for retrieving the list of contacts (property managers and tenants) available to the subcontractor, ensuring data security and appropriate access control.
Create a user interface component for displaying contacts. This component should allow selection of one or multiple recipients for a message from the list of contacts.
Develop a text input component in the frontend for message composition. This component should include a text box and a send button.

Implement the send message functionality in the backend. This includes creating API endpoints for message submission, handling message storage, and ensuring messages are tagged with sender and receiver IDs.
Integrate real-time messaging capabilities using WebSocket or similar technology to allow messages to be received as soon as they are sent.
Build a message display component in the frontend for showing conversation threads in a chat window. Ensure messages are displayed in chronological order.
Ensure the chat system has proper error handling mechanisms for failed message deliveries and displays appropriate notifications to the user.
Conduct unit testing on the messaging API to ensure that messages are sent and received correctly between users and that all edge cases are handled.

Perform integration testing to verify that the frontend components interact correctly with the backend services and that the overall workflow of selecting a contact, composing a message, and sending/receiving messages functions seamlessly.
Plan and execute a security review to ensure that message data is transmitted securely and that unauthorized users cannot access messages or contact lists.
Develop clear and comprehensive documentation for the chat system that covers the setup, known issues, troubleshooting tips, and usage guidelines to assist both developers and end-users.

E003.Epic Description: Facilitate effective communication between subcontractors, property managers, and tenants through an integrated chat system to discuss job details and coordinate schedules.
E003.Story Description: As a subcontractor, I want to receive and view messages from property managers and tenants so that I can keep up-to-date with job requirements and scheduling.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Incoming messages are notified with an alert.
Messages are displayed in chronological order in the chat window.
Subcontractors can view the sender’s name and message timestamp.
Read/unread status is visible for each message.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to store messages, including fields for message ID, sender ID, recipient ID, message content, timestamp, and read/unread status.

Create a backend service to handle the receipt and storage of incoming messages from tenants and property managers, ensuring that each message is stored with the correct timestamp and initially marked as unread.
Implement an API endpoint that allows retrieval of messages for a subcontractor, sorted in chronological order, and includes sender information and timestamp.
Develop a real-time notification system that alerts subcontractors of new incoming messages through an in-app alert mechanism.
Integrate the message retrieval API with the frontend, displaying messages in a chat window in chronological order.
Implement functionality on the frontend for subcontractors to mark messages as read, which updates the read/unread status in the database.
Ensure the frontend displays the read/unread status of each message clearly, allowing subcontractors to easily distinguish between them.
Conduct integration tests to verify that messages are received, stored, and retrieved correctly, ensuring all components of the messaging system work together seamlessly.

Perform user acceptance testing with mock data to ensure that the message notification, display functionalities, and read/unread status features meet the subcontractor's needs as described in the user story.

E003.Epic Description: Facilitate effective communication between subcontractors, property managers, and tenants through an integrated chat system to discuss job details and coordinate schedules.
E003.Story Description: As a subcontractor, I want to create group chats including myself, tenants, and property managers so that we can coordinate more efficiently on projects requiring multiple stakeholders.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Option to create a new group chat from the communication dashboard.
Ability to select multiple contacts to add to the group chat.
Group chat allows for messages to be sent and received by all members.
Members receive notifications when added to a group chat.

Tasks.Description: Design the database schema to support group chat functionality, including tables for groups, group members, and group messages.
Implement backend API to handle creation of new group chats. This includes receiving data on new group names and members, creating records in the database, and returning success or error responses.
Create a service in the backend to manage adding and removing members from existing group chats, including database operations and appropriate error handling.
Develop backend functionality to store messages sent in group chats, ensuring that they are linked to the correct group and can be retrieved efficiently.
Implement real-time messaging within group chats using WebSocket or a similar technology to allow for interactive communication among group members.
Construct a user interface on the communication dashboard for creating new group chats. This should include form inputs for the group name and a multi-select option for adding members.
Enhance the communication dashboard interface to display existing group chats and allow users to select a chat to view its messages and participate in the discussion.
Add functionality to the frontend for members to receive real-time notifications when they are added to group chats, using push notifications or similar technology.
Ensure that all members of a group chat can send and receive messages smoothly, with proper synchronization across different devices.
Conduct thorough testing of the group chat feature, including unit tests for database interactions, API endpoints, and integration tests for the overall chat functionality.
Prepare documentation for the group chat feature, covering its use, technical details, and troubleshooting common issues for both developers and end-users.
Deploy the group chat functionality to the staging environment and conduct user acceptance testing to ensure it meets the needs articulated in the user story and acceptance criteria.

E003.Epic Description: Facilitate effective communication between subcontractors, property managers, and tenants through an integrated chat system to discuss job details and coordinate schedules.
E003.Story Description: As a subcontractor, I want to upload and share files within the chat system so that I can provide visual details or documents related to the maintenance jobs.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Feature to attach files within the message composer.
Support for common file types (e.g., PDF, JPG, DOCX).
Files are scanned for viruses upon upload.
Recipients can download and view files directly from the chat.

Tasks.Description: Design a file attachment feature in the chat system's message composer interface, ensuring it is user-friendly and allows users to easily upload files.
Implement backend support to handle file uploads. This includes setting up a server endpoint that receives files, saves them securely, and maintains an association with the chat messages.
Develop functionality to support multiple file types for uploads, specifically PDF, JPG, and DOCX formats. Ensure the system can correctly identify and process these file formats.
Integrate a virus scanning API to automatically scan all uploaded files for viruses before they are saved or made accessible to other users.

Conduct integration testing to ensure that the job listings interface works seamlessly with the backend API and the job applications are submitted and stored correctly.
