E006.Epic Description: Implement a system where subcontractors can receive feedback and ratings from property managers and tenants, helping to build their reputation in the community.
E006.Story Title: Job Completion and Initiation of Feedback
E006.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to mark jobs as completed and initiate the feedback process so that I can ensure my services are adequately reviewed.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Subcontractors can mark a job as completed in the system.
Upon marking as completed, the property manager and tenant are notified to leave feedback.
The system should capture the date of completion.
A reminder for feedback submission is sent to the property manager and tenant if not submitted within a specified timeframe.

Tasks.Description: Implement a function `mark_job_as_completed(job_id, subcontractor_id)` that allows subcontractors to mark a job as completed by updating the job status in the database. Inputs include `job_id` and `subcontractor_id`. Output should confirm the update status.

Develop a notification system within the `mark_job_as_completed` function to automatically send a notification to the property manager and tenant associated with the job. This function should retrieve contact information based on the `job_id` and send notifications accordingly.
Modify the job completion function to capture and store the date and time when a job is marked as completed. This information should be recorded in the jobs database linked by `job_id`.

Create a scheduler function `schedule_feedback_reminder(job_id)` that triggers a reminder for feedback submission if it has not been received within a specified timeframe. The function should check the status of feedback and schedule a reminder using a time-based trigger.

E006.Epic Description: Implement a system where subcontractors can receive feedback and ratings from property managers and tenants, helping to build their reputation in the community.
E006.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to access my historical feedback and ratings to evaluate my performance over time.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Subcontractors can access a dashboard showing all past feedback and ratings.
Feedback history can be filtered by date, job type, or property manager.
The system provides average rating calculation based on historical data.
Feedback details are expandable for full review directly on the dashboard.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for the subcontractor's dashboard that includes a section specifically for viewing feedback history. The interface should allow feedback to be displayed in a list format with options for expanding each entry to view more detailed information.

Implement a backend service to fetch all feedback and ratings from the database associated with the logged-in subcontractor. This service should retrieve data including the date of feedback, job type, property manager's details, rating, and textual feedback.

Create a filter functionality on the front end that allows subcontractors to filter their feedback and ratings history by date, job type, or property manager. This should dynamically update the feedback displayed based on the selected filters.

Develop a function to calculate the average rating from the historical feedback data retrieved. This function should handle the computation on the server side and send the result to the frontend to be displayed on the subcontractor's dashboard.

Integrate expand/collapse functionality in the feedback list on the dashboard, allowing subcontractors to click on an entry to view detailed feedback including textual comments, images if available, and any responses from property managers or tenants.
Ensure data security and privacy by implementing proper authentication and authorization checks to make sure that subcontractors can only access their own feedback and ratings.

Conduct unit testing for backend services to ensure that the feedback retrieval, filtering functionality, and average rating calculations are accurate and perform efficiently under different scenarios.
Set up frontend integration tests to verify that the dashboard correctly displays feedback history, filters work as expected, and user interactions like expanding feedback details function smoothly.

Prepare database migrations or scripts necessary to support any new data structures or queries required for storing and retrieving subcontractor feedback and implementing the filtering and averaging features.

Document the API endpoints and frontend component behaviors developed for this feature to assist in future maintenance and provide clear guidelines for other developers or teams interfacing with this functionality.

E006.Epic Description: Implement a system where subcontractors can receive feedback and ratings from property managers and tenants, helping to build their reputation in the community.
E006.Story Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to be able to dispute unfair ratings or feedback to maintain my reputation integrity.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Feature to flag feedback for review available on the subcontractor's dashboard.
Flagger must provide a reason and any evidence supporting their dispute claim.
Disputed feedback is reviewed by an administrator with a response time of no more than 5 business days.
Subcontractors are notified of the dispute outcome, and adjustments are made if necessary.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a 'Flag for Review' feature on the subcontractor's dashboard. This feature allows subcontractors to flag any feedback they consider unfair.
Create a form associated with the 'Flag for Review' feature where subcontractors can submit a reason and any evidence supporting their dispute claim.
Develop backend functionality to store and manage flagged feedback, including storing reasons and evidence provided by the subcontractor.
Implement an administrative review interface where administrators can view flagged feedback, reasons for disputes, and attached evidence.
Develop a system for administrators to approve or deny disputes. If a dispute is approved, the necessary adjustments should be made to the feedback.
Create an automated notification system to inform subcontractors about the outcome of their dispute within 5 business days.
Ensure that any adjustments to feedback after a successful dispute are reflected immediately on the platform.
Conduct security and privacy checks to ensure that all submitted evidence and reasons for disputes are securely handled and accessible only to authorized personnel.
Setup unit and integration tests to validate the functionality of the feedback dispute process, including data handling, administrator review operations, and notification dispatch.
Prepare documentation for the feedback dispute feature, detailing usage for subcontractors and administrators, and outlining the process flow and expected outcomes.

E001.Epic Description: Enable tenants to securely log in and out of the platform using their registered credentials, and manage their session with features like 'Remember Me' and 'Forgot Password'.
E001.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to log in using my registered email and password so that I can access my personal dashboard and manage my rental details securely.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant must be able to enter an email and password.
System validates credentials against the database.
Tenant is redirected to their personal dashboard upon successful login.
An error message is displayed if the login fails.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for the tenant login page. The interface should include fields for entering an email and a password, along with a submit button.
Implement the front-end logic for collecting the email and password from the input fields on the login form.
Develop the back-end API to handle POST requests that contain the tenant's email and password. This API will check the credentials against the database.
Set up a database schema to store tenant credentials securely, ensuring that passwords are hashed before storage.
Create a session management system to handle successful logins, generating a session token that will be used to maintain the user's state across multiple requests.
Implement logic to redirect the tenant to their personal dashboard upon successful login, using the session token to fetch and display personalized information.
Develop a mechanism to handle failed login attempts, including providing an error message when the email or password does not match the records in the database.
Ensure all data transmitted during the login process is secured using HTTPS to protect the confidentiality and integrity of the tenant’s credentials.
Conduct unit and integration tests to ensure the login functionality works as expected under various scenarios, including both successful and unsuccessful login attempts.
Write comprehensive documentation on the login functionality that includes details on the request and response formats, expected behaviors, and error handling.

E001.Epic Description: Enable tenants to securely log in and out of the platform using their registered credentials, and manage their session with features like 'Remember Me' and 'Forgot Password'.
E001.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want the system to remember my login credentials on my device so that I do not have to re-enter them every time I access the platform.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Option for 'Remember Me' is visible on the login page.
If selected, the system stores the Tenant's credentials securely.
On subsequent visits, the login fields are pre-populated with the stored credentials.
Tenant must be able to opt-out of this feature by deselecting 'Remember Me'.

Tasks.Description: Design a UI component for the 'Remember Me' checkbox on the login page, ensuring it is clearly visible and accessible according to accessibility standards.

Implement secure storage for stored credentials using encryption methodologies such as AES-256. This involves modifying the backend to encrypt and safely store the credentials when 'Remember Me' is selected.
Modify the login process to check for stored credentials when a tenant visits the login page. If stored credentials exist and the 'Remember Me' option was selected, auto-populate the login fields.
Provide a UI option on the login page for tenants to deselect 'Remember Me', which should trigger the clearing of stored credentials from the device and secure storage.
Conduct a security assessment to ensure that the implementation of the 'Remember Me' functionality complies with best practices for data protection and privacy.
Implement unit tests to verify that the 'Remember Me' functionality correctly encrypts and stores credentials, auto-populates login fields, and allows for opt-out by clearing stored data.
Prepare user documentation that explains the 'Remember Me' feature, detailing how to use it and how to opt-out, as well as the security measures taken to protect stored credentials.

E001.Epic Description: Enable tenants to securely log in and out of the platform using their registered credentials, and manage their session with features like 'Remember Me' and 'Forgot Password'.
E001.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to reset my password if I forget it so that I can regain access to my account.
Story Acceptance Criteria: A 'Forgot Password' link is available on the login page.
Tenant can enter their registered email address to receive a reset link.
Tenant receives an email with a link to reset their password.
Tenant can create a new password after clicking the reset link.
Tenant can log in with the new password.

Tasks.Description: Design the 'Forgot Password' link on the tenant login page, ensuring it is clearly visible and accessible.
Implement backend functionality to handle 'Forgot Password' requests, including validating the tenant's email address against the database.
Develop functionality to generate a secure, unique password reset link that expires after a predefined time (e.g., 24 hours).
Create an email template for the password reset link, ensuring it includes clear instructions on how to reset the password.
Set up an email service to send the password reset link to the tenant's registered email address upon request.
Develop a password reset page that tenants are redirected to upon clicking the reset link, allowing them to enter and confirm a new password.
Implement password validation rules on the reset page to ensure strong password creation (e.g., minimum length, inclusion of numbers and symbols).
Ensure the tenant's password is securely updated in the database once they submit the new password.
Provide clear confirmation to the tenant on the password reset page after successful password update.
Test the end-to-end functionality of the password reset process, from link generation to email delivery and password update, to ensure security and reliability.

E001.Epic Description: Enable tenants to securely log in and out of the platform using their registered credentials, and manage their session with features like 'Remember Me' and 'Forgot Password'.
E001.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to securely log out from the platform so that I can ensure my account remains secure when I'm not using it.
Story Acceptance Criteria: A 'Logout' option is available in the user interface.
Clicking 'Logout' ends the session and redirects the user to the login page.
After logging out, user must log in again to access personal data.

Tasks.Description: Design a 'Logout' button on the user interface ensuring it is visually consistent with the platform's design guidelines and easily accessible across all pages where user authentication is required.

Implement the backend functionality to handle the logout process. This should include terminating the user's session, clearing any session-related data stored locally or in the server, and ensuring no unauthorized access is possible after the session ends.

Configure the server to redirect the user to the login page immediately after the logout process is completed. This redirection should be secure and must confirm that the user session has been effectively ended.

Set up unit tests to verify that clicking the 'Logout' button effectively ends the user session, clears relevant data, and redirects to the login page. Ensure that after logging out, subsequent attempts to access user-specific data without logging in again are blocked.
Create integration tests to ensure that the logout process interacts correctly with other components of the authentication system, such as session management and data privacy safeguards.

Develop user documentation and tooltips for the logout functionality to inform users about the importance of logging out after they have finished using the platform. Ensure the documentation is clear and accessible within the platform's help or FAQ sections.

E001.Epic Description: Enable tenants to securely log in and out of the platform using their registered credentials, and manage their session with features like 'Remember Me' and 'Forgot Password'.
E001.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want my login session to automatically timeout after a period of inactivity so that my account is protected from unauthorized access.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Session times out after 15 minutes of inactivity.
Tenant is notified about the impending timeout 1 minute before with an option to extend the session.
Upon timeout, the Tenant is automatically logged out and redirected to the login page.
Tenant must log in again to access the account.

Tasks.Description: Implement session management to track user activity and detect inactivity. Create a function to set a timeout threshold of 15 minutes.
Develop a function to send an in-app notification to the tenant 1 minute before the session timeout, offering an option to extend the session.
Create a function to automatically logout the tenant once the session times out after 15 minutes of inactivity. This function should redirect the tenant to the login page.
Set up session re-initialization requiring the tenant to log in again after being automatically logged out due to inactivity.
Ensure integration of the timeout notification and logout functionalities with the front-end user interface to provide a seamless user experience.
Perform unit testing on each function to ensure they correctly handle session timeout, notification, and re-authentication processes.
Conduct integration testing to verify the coordination between the backend session management and the front-end user interface notifications and redirections.
Document the implementation details, particularly how the session timeout and extension options work, for future reference and maintenance.

E002.Epic Description: Allow tenants to create, view, and update their profiles with personal and contact information, manage their bank/card details for payments, and handle their documents.
E002.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to create my profile with personal and contact information so that I can manage my rental interactions securely and efficiently.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can enter and save personal information such as full name, date of birth, and contact details.
Tenant can upload a photograph for identification.
The system validates mandatory fields and provides error messages if incomplete.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface form on the tenant dashboard for profile creation that includes input fields for full name, date of birth, and contact details such as phone number and email address.
Implement a file upload component in the user interface that allows tenants to upload a photograph for their profile.

Develop input validation logic for the profile creation form to check for the presence of all mandatory fields: full name, date of birth, contact details, and a photograph. Ensure that each field adheres to expected formats, such as valid email addresses and reasonable character limits for names and addresses.

Create error handling mechanisms that display informative and user-friendly messages when mandatory fields are missing or input data does not meet validation criteria. Error messages should guide tenants on how to correct their inputs.
Integrate the profile creation form with the backend database to save tenant profiles. Ensure fields are properly mapped and data is stored securely.
Implement a confirmation mechanism that notifies the tenant upon successful saving of their profile. This could be in the form of a message on the user interface or a confirmation email.
Set up server-side logic to handle file uploads securely, ensuring that uploaded photographs are stored in a secure location and are linked to the corresponding tenant profile.

Conduct tests to ensure that the profile creation form accurately captures and saves all required information and that error handling correctly responds to various invalid or incomplete input scenarios.

Ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling personal and sensitive information of tenants. Implement necessary security measures such as data encryption and secure data storage practices.

E002.Epic Description: Allow tenants to create, view, and update their profiles with personal and contact information, manage their bank/card details for payments, and handle their documents.
E002.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to view my profile details so that I can verify my personal information and ensure it is up to date.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can view all personal and contact information previously entered.
Profile viewing is secure and only accessible after tenant login.

Tasks.Description: Develop a secure authentication system for tenants to log into the platform, ensuring that profile viewing is only accessible after successful authentication.
Create a database schema to store tenant personal and contact information securely. Include fields such as full name, email, phone number, address, and any other relevant information.
Implement backend logic to retrieve and send tenant information from the database to the front end only after successful login verification.
Design and develop a user interface for tenants to view their profile details. This interface should display all personal and contact information in a readable and organized format.
Ensure all data transmission between the server and client is encrypted to maintain data privacy and security.
Conduct unit tests to verify that the profile information is accurately retrieved from the database and displayed correctly to the user.
Perform security testing to confirm that profile viewing is inaccessible without proper authentication and that there are no vulnerabilities allowing unauthorized access.
Arrange for a user acceptance testing session with tenants to gather feedback on the ease of use and security of the profile viewing functionality.

E002.Epic Description: Allow tenants to create, view, and update their profiles with personal and contact information, manage their bank/card details for payments, and handle their documents.
E002.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to update my profile with new or changed personal and contact information so that my rental interactions remain current and accurate.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can edit and save changes to any personal or contact information.
The system confirms successful updates with a notification.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface form for tenants to edit their personal and contact information. This form should include fields such as name, date of birth, phone number, and email address.
Implement input validation for the edit profile form to ensure all data entered by the tenant meets the required format, such as proper email format and valid phone numbers.
Develop a backend service to handle requests for updating tenant profile information. This service should authenticate the user, validate the request data, and update the information in the database.
Create a database schema to support storing and updating tenant personal and contact information, ensuring data integrity and appropriate indexing for performance.
Implement a notification system that triggers a confirmation message to the tenant once their profile information has been successfully updated. The message should be clear and informative.
Write unit tests for the backend service to validate the functionality of updating tenant information, including checks for data validation, user authentication, and successful data storage.
Configure security settings to ensure that only authenticated tenants can update their own information, preventing unauthorized access or changes.
Integrate the front-end and back-end components for updating tenant profiles, ensuring a seamless user experience with real-time feedback on the page when data is successfully updated.
Perform integration testing to ensure the entire process from the user interface to the database update functions correctly and the confirmation notification is sent successfully.
Deploy the updated profile editing functionality to the staging environment for user acceptance testing, ensuring it meets the criteria set forth in the user story.

E002.Epic Description: Allow tenants to create, view, and update their profiles with personal and contact information, manage their bank/card details for payments, and handle their documents.
E002.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to manage my bank or card details for payments so that I can handle my financial transactions securely within the platform.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can add, view, and delete bank or card information.
The platform provides secure data handling compliant with financial regulations.

Tasks.Description: Design a secure form component on the tenant's dashboard for inputting bank or card information. The form should include fields for the cardholder's name, card number, expiration date, and CVV.
Implement form validations to ensure the card details are in the correct format before submission. Include checks for the validity of the card number, expiration date, and CVV.
Develop a secure backend API endpoint to handle the submission of bank or card details. This endpoint must encrypt the card data before storing it in the database.
Create a database schema for storing encrypted bank or card information, ensuring that it complies with financial regulations and data protection laws.
Implement a feature on the tenant's dashboard to retrieve and decrypt bank or card information for viewing, ensuring that the data is presented securely to the authenticated tenant only.
Develop functionality that allows the tenant to delete their stored bank or card information, including the backend logic to securely remove the data from the database.
Ensure that all transmissions of sensitive bank or card information between the client and the server are encrypted using TLS.
Conduct a security audit of the implemented features to ensure compliance with financial regulations and secure data handling practices.
Write unit and integration tests for the new form, API endpoints, and data handling logic to ensure that they function correctly and securely.
Update the platform's documentation to include instructions for tenants on how to manage their bank or card details securely.

E002.Epic Description: Allow tenants to create, view, and update their profiles with personal and contact information, manage their bank/card details for payments, and handle their documents.
E002.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to upload, view, and manage my documents such as lease agreements and identity proofs so that I can maintain necessary records digitally.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can upload documents in supported formats (e.g., PDF, JPG).
Tenant can view a list of all uploaded documents.
Tenant can delete documents no longer needed.

Tasks.Description: Design a document upload interface in the tenant dashboard. Include form elements to accept files, specifically filtering for PDF, JPG, and other specified formats.
Implement backend functionality to handle file uploads. Store documents in a secure, scalable cloud storage solution with metadata including tenant ID, upload date, and file type.
Develop a document retrieval API that fetches the list of all documents uploaded by a tenant. This should include document name, upload date, and a link to view/download the document.

Create a frontend component on the tenant dashboard to display the list of uploaded documents. Use a table or list format with columns or fields for document name, upload date, and actions (e.g., view, delete).
Implement a document deletion API that allows tenants to remove documents they no longer need. Ensure this API checks that the document belongs to the requesting tenant before deletion.
Add a confirmation dialog in the frontend when a tenant tries to delete a document, to prevent accidental deletions. The dialog should require the tenant to confirm the deletion action.
Ensure security measures are in place for document management, including authentication checks and encryption of documents in transit and at rest.

Conduct thorough testing of the document upload, retrieval, and deletion functionalities to ensure they are secure, efficient, and user-friendly. Include tests for handling different file sizes and formats.
Prepare documentation for tenants on how to manage their documents on the platform, detailing how to upload, view, and delete documents.
Deploy the new document management functionalities to the staging environment for integration testing, ensuring that it interacts seamlessly with existing tenant profile features.

E002.Epic Description: Allow tenants to create, view, and update their profiles with personal and contact information, manage their bank/card details for payments, and handle their documents.
E002.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to log in to the platform using my registered credentials so that I can access my personal tenant profile and related functionalities securely.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can log in using an email address and password.
The system provides error messages for invalid login attempts.
Successful login directs the tenant to their dashboard.

Tasks.Description: Design the database schema for tenant authentication, including tables for storing tenant credentials (email address and hashed password).

Implement backend functionality to handle tenant login requests. This includes receiving login data (email and password), validating these credentials against the database, and handling authentication logic.
Develop a secure login API endpoint that accepts email and password, checks them against the stored values in the database, and returns an authentication token if the credentials are correct.
Create error handling for the login process to catch and return appropriate error messages for common issues such as incorrect password, non-existent email address, and system errors.

Set up a session management system to maintain tenant login state across different pages of the application. This includes generating a session token upon successful login and managing session expiration.
Implement frontend login functionality including a form for email and password input, submission handling, and display of error messages based on the server response.

Integrate the frontend login system with the backend API to authenticate users, handling the response to redirect tenants to their dashboard upon successful login or display error messages if there are issues.
Conduct unit testing on the backend login functionality to ensure that it correctly handles valid and invalid login attempts, properly generating session tokens, and accurately reports errors.

Perform integration testing to ensure the frontend and backend login systems work seamlessly together, correctly managing sessions and properly redirecting and informing the user upon both successful and failed login attempts.

Implement security best practices for the login process, including SSL/TLS encryption for data transmission, hashing and salting of passwords, and prevention mechanisms for SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS).

Deploy the login functionality to a staging environment for end-to-end testing, including user interaction simulations to verify the complete flow from login form submission to dashboard redirection or error notification.

E002.Epic Description: Allow tenants to create, view, and update their profiles with personal and contact information, manage their bank/card details for payments, and handle their documents.
E002.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to recover or reset my password if I forget it so that I can regain access to my profile without compromising security.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can initiate a password reset via a registered email link.
Tenant receives clear instructions for resetting their password.
The system confirms the successful password update.

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for the password reset page, including fields for entering the email address and a submit button.
Implement backend API to handle password reset requests, which should verify if the email exists in the database, generate a secure token, and send the password reset link via email.
Configure the email service to send password reset emails, ensuring that the email contains a clickable link with the secure token and clear instructions on how to reset the password.
Create the password reset form that users will be directed to from the link in their email. This form should include fields for the new password and password confirmation.
Implement validation on the new password to ensure it meets security standards (e.g., minimum length, contains numbers, and special characters).
Update the database to save the new password securely, ensuring the previous password is overwritten only after successful validation.
Ensure that the password reset link expires after a set duration for security purposes, and implement checks to handle expired links appropriately.
Develop functionality to confirm the password has been successfully updated, which could include a confirmation message on the website and an optional confirmation email.
Test the complete password reset flow, including email delivery, link validation, password update, and user notifications, to ensure all components work harmoniously and securely.
Document the password reset process and update the tenant help/support sections to assist users in recovering their passwords effectively.

E003.Epic Description: Provide tenants with functionalities to search for properties based on various filters, view listings with detailed information, and manage their saved/bookmarked properties.
E003.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to search for properties using various filters such as location, price range, and amenities so that I can find listings that match my specific needs.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can select multiple filters such as location, property type, number of rooms, and price range.
Filters for advanced options like pet policy and amenities are available and functional.
Results update dynamically as filters are applied.
No results found message is displayed when no properties match the criteria.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a property search API that handles queries with multiple filters such as location, property type, number of rooms, and price range. This API should support querying a database and returning relevant properties.

Develop user interface components for property search, including dropdowns, checkboxes, and sliders to allow tenants to select and combine filters like location, property type, rooms, price range, pet policy, and amenities.

Implement front-end logic to dynamically update the list of available properties as the user changes filters, ensuring interactions are responsive and reflect the current state of the filters without needing a page refresh.

Create a backend functionality to handle cases where no properties match the selected criteria. This should trigger a clear, user-friendly message on the frontend, informing the tenant that no results were found and suggesting alternative search criteria.

E003.Epic Description: Provide tenants with functionalities to search for properties based on various filters, view listings with detailed information, and manage their saved/bookmarked properties.
E003.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to view detailed information about properties so that I can assess if the property fits my requirements before scheduling a visit or applying.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Detailed page for each property listing is accessible.
Property details include images, floor plans, property rules, amenities, and contact information.
All listed details are correctly populated from the database.

Tasks.Description: Design the database schema for property listings, including tables for properties, images, floor plans, rules, amenities, and contact information. Ensure all necessary details such as property ID, address, size, price, and owner information are included.

Implement a function 'fetch_property_details(property_id)' in Python that queries the database to retrieve all details related to a specific property using its property ID. This function should return a dictionary containing all property details, including images, floor plans, and amenities.

Develop a REST API endpoint '/properties/{property_id}' that uses the 'fetch_property_details' function to provide property details. Ensure the API handles requests securely and returns data in JSON format.

Create a user interface for the property detail page that dynamically displays information retrieved from the API. The page should include sections for images, floor plans, property rules, amenities, and contact information.
Implement error handling in the API and UI to manage scenarios where property details are incomplete or the property ID does not exist in the database. Display appropriate error messages to the user.
Set up unit tests for the 'fetch_property_details' function and the API endpoint to ensure they handle different types of inputs correctly and fetch data accurately from the database.
Conduct integration testing to verify that the API and user interface work seamlessly together and that property details are displayed correctly and in full on the property detail page.
Add accessibility features to the property details page, such as alt text for images and proper headings structure, to ensure the page is usable by people with disabilities.

Perform a security review of the API endpoint to ensure it is protected against common vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS). Implement necessary security measures such as input validation and output encoding.

E003.Epic Description: Provide tenants with functionalities to search for properties based on various filters, view listings with detailed information, and manage their saved/bookmarked properties.
E003.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to save or bookmark properties so that I can easily return to them later without having to search again.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenants can click a save or bookmark icon on the property listings.
Saved properties are accessible through a 'Saved Properties' section in the user's profile.
Tenants can remove properties from their saved list.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a 'Save' or 'Bookmark' icon on each property listing in the user interface. The icon should be visually distinct and placed in a consistent location across listings.
Create a backend API endpoint to handle the save or bookmark action. This endpoint should accept the property ID and user ID, and update the database to reflect the saved property for the user.

Develop the functionality in the user's profile section to display a 'Saved Properties' list. This should retrieve and show all properties that the user has saved, with options to view each property in detail.

Implement a backend API endpoint to fetch the list of saved properties for a given user. The endpoint should return all relevant property details needed to display them in the user's 'Saved Properties' section.
Create a remove option for each property in the 'Saved Properties' list. This should allow users to unsave or unbookmark properties they no longer wish to keep in their list.

Set up a backend API endpoint to handle the removal of saved properties. This endpoint should accept the property ID and user ID and update the database to remove the property from the user's saved list.
Ensure all new endpoints are secured and only accessible by authenticated users to prevent unauthorized access to saving or modifying saved properties.
Conduct unit testing for the new backend endpoints to ensure they handle save and remove actions correctly, handle errors gracefully, and only allow access to authenticated users.
Conduct integration testing to verify that the frontend and backend work together seamlessly, allowing users to save, view, and remove saved properties without issues.
Update the user interface to ensure that any changes in the saved properties list (both additions and removals) are reflected in real time without needing to refresh the page.
Perform end-to-end testing to simulate the user experience and confirm that users can manage their saved properties as expected across different devices and browsers.
Prepare user documentation that explains how to use the new save and unsave property features, including screenshots and step-by-step instructions.

E003.Epic Description: Provide tenants with functionalities to search for properties based on various filters, view listings with detailed information, and manage their saved/bookmarked properties.
E003.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to apply for a lease directly from the property details page so that I can initiate the rental process efficiently.
Story Acceptance Criteria: A 'Apply for Lease' button is available on each property detail page.
Clicking the button opens a form where the tenant can submit their application.
Confirmation is shown after successfully submitting the application.
The property owner receives the application for review.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a 'Apply for Lease' button on each property detail page. The button must be clearly visible and accessible, ensuring proper UI and UX principles are followed.

Develop the backend API that will handle the form submission when a tenant applies for a lease. This API should capture all necessary details from the tenant's application form and store them securely in the database.

Create a front-end lease application form that is triggered when a tenant clicks the 'Apply for Lease' button. The form should include all required fields as per the property's application requirements. Include client-side validation to ensure all fields are filled out before submission.

Implement server-side validation for the lease application form submission to ensure data integrity and security. This includes validating that all required fields are provided and the data format is correct.

Develop a confirmation message that displays after a tenant successfully submits a lease application. The message should be clear and inform the tenant that their application has been received and is under review.

Tenants can reschedule or cancel appointments with notifications sent to property managers.

Implement a backend service to handle scheduling requests. This service should communicate with the calendar API to book the selected time slot and update the calendar entries accordingly.

Create an email notification system that triggers a confirmation email to both the tenant and the property manager once a visit is scheduled. The email should include details of the time slot and any relevant property information.

Develop functionality to allow tenants to reschedule appointments. This should include updating the calendar event via the API and sending updated email confirmations to both the tenant and the property manager.
Implement the capability for tenants to cancel scheduled appointments. This should remove the calendar event via the integrated API and notify the property manager through an automated email.
Ensure that all changes made to appointments (scheduling, rescheduling, canceling) are logged in the system's backend for auditability and tracking purposes.

Develop a system to provide instant feedback and confirmation once profile changes are saved successfully. This could include a popup message or a notification bar on the dashboard indicating the successful update of profile information.

Error message displayed for incorrect credentials.

Tenant can set a new password using the link.

Tasks.Description: Design the UI for the password recovery option on the login page ensuring the 'Forgot Password?' link is clearly visible and accessible.

Configure the email service to send a password reset email containing a secure, unique, and time-bound link to the tenant's registered email address.

Develop a password reset page that is accessed via the link sent to the user's email. This page should allow the tenant to input and confirm a new password. Include validations for password strength and matching confirmation.

System validates the data before submission to ensure all required fields are filled.
Tenant receives confirmation of submission.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface form for lease application submissions on the platform, including fields for necessary details such as tenant name, address, desired property, income level, employment status, and reference contacts.

Ensure the application form supports attachments, allowing tenants to upload necessary documents such as proof of income, identity verification, and previous rental history.
Implement security measures such as HTTPS for data transmission and encryption for sensitive data stored in the database to protect tenant information.
Conduct unit testing on the lease application submission process to ensure that all components (form interface, validation logic, API endpoint) work correctly and handle errors as expected.
Set up an email notification system that sends an automated email to the tenant confirming the receipt of their lease application and providing them with a reference number for future inquiries.
Integrate the lease application system with the tenant's dashboard, allowing them to view the status of their submitted applications and any updates or requests for additional information.

E004.Epic Description: Facilitate tenants to apply for leases, view the status of their applications, manage ongoing leases, and handle lease renewals and terminations.

Functionality to download or request physical copies of lease documents.

Integrate functionality to securely store and retrieve digital copies of lease documents associated with each tenant's lease.

Ensure all data transmissions involving lease details and documents are encrypted and comply with privacy standards.
Perform comprehensive testing on the lease management features to ensure they work as expected and handle errors gracefully.
Deploy the updated features to the live environment once testing is complete and verified.

E004.Epic Description: Facilitate tenants to apply for leases, view the status of their applications, manage ongoing leases, and handle lease renewals and terminations.
E004.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to manage lease renewals through the platform so that I can easily extend my stay without administrative hassles.

Tenant can initiate lease renewal directly through the platform.
System guides tenant through any changes in terms or conditions for the renewal process.

Tasks.Description: Create a function to calculate the two-month notification period for lease expiration. Inputs should include the lease end date, and the output should be the date when the notification should be sent.

Develop a notification system that triggers an alert for lease renewals two months in advance. This should use the function developed to calculate the notification period and send alerts via both email and in-app notification to the tenant.

Implement a lease renewal initiation feature on the tenant dashboard. Include an interface element (like a button or link) that allows tenants to start the renewal process. This feature should be visible and accessible only to tenants whose lease is approaching the expiration date within two months.

Design and implement a guided renewal process that provides tenants with step-by-step assistance through any changes in lease terms or conditions. This should include displaying current lease terms and editable fields for any changes the tenant wishes to make.

Ensure that the system updates the lease end date and terms in the database once the tenant submits the renewal form. This should trigger a confirmation message to the tenant, and an update should be sent to the property manager regarding the renewal.

Create automated testing scripts to validate the notification scheduling, the display of the renewal initiation interface, and the correct functioning of the guided renewal process. This should include checks for timely notifications and the accuracy of information provided during the renewal process.

E004.Epic Description: Facilitate tenants to apply for leases, view the status of their applications, manage ongoing leases, and handle lease renewals and terminations.
E004.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to initiate lease terminations when necessary so that I can end my lease officially and in compliance with rental agreements.

Tenant must confirm the request after being shown any potential fees or penalties.
Tenant receives a checklist of tasks to complete before vacating (e.g., cleaning, key return).
Confirmation of lease termination is recorded and visible in the tenant’s history.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for tenants to initiate lease termination requests, featuring a clear 'Request Termination' button and description of the process.
Develop a backend service to process lease termination requests, which validates tenant identity and authorization to terminate the lease.
Implement a confirmation dialog in the lease termination process that informs tenants of any fees or penalties associated with early termination, and requires their explicit consent to proceed.
Create a checklist interface for tenants to access and complete pre-termination tasks such as cleaning and key return, with checkboxes for each required action.
Develop a functionality to record the completion of the lease termination in the tenant’s account history, ensuring that it includes timestamp and relevant details of the termination.
Integrate email notification services to send tenants a confirmation email once their lease termination is processed and recorded, including a summary of the termination details.
Ensure that all tenant data related to the lease termination is securely handled and comply with data protection regulations.
Perform thorough testing of the lease termination feature to validate functionality, security, and user experience across different devices and platforms.
Prepare user help documentation and tooltips within the application to assist tenants in understanding the lease termination process and any associated responsibilities or fees.

E004.Epic Description: Facilitate tenants to apply for leases, view the status of their applications, manage ongoing leases, and handle lease renewals and terminations.
E004.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to recover or reset my password so that I can regain access to my account if I forget my password.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can request a password reset from the login page.
Tenant receives a password reset link via email.
Tenant can create a new password following secure password guidelines.
Tenant can log in with the new password.

Tasks.Description: Design a password reset form on the tenant login page. The form should include an input field for the tenant to enter their registered email address and a submit button to request a password reset.

Implement backend functionality to handle password reset requests. This includes verifying the email address against the database, generating a secure password reset link, and sending the link to the tenant's registered email address.
Create an email template for password reset notifications. The email should contain the secure password reset link and instructions on how to reset the password.

Develop the password reset page that tenants are redirected to via the email link. This page should allow tenants to input a new password and confirm it. Include validations to ensure the new password follows secure password guidelines.
Integrate the password reset functionality with the authentication system, ensuring that once the new password is set, it is securely hashed and stored in the database, replacing the old password.
Implement logic to invalidate the password reset link after it has been used or after a set expiration time to ensure security.
Ensure that tenants can log in with the new password by updating the login authentication process to check against the newly set password.
Perform thorough testing of the password reset process, including edge cases such as invalid or expired links, incorrect email inputs, and weak password attempts.
Document the password reset process and update any related user help documentation to guide tenants through the password recovery steps.
Implement security measures such as rate limiting on password reset requests and encrypting the password reset links to protect against brute force attacks and interception.

E004.Epic Description: Facilitate tenants to apply for leases, view the status of their applications, manage ongoing leases, and handle lease renewals and terminations.
E004.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to securely log into the platform so that my personal and lease information remains protected.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant logs in using a username and password.
System provides an option for two-factor authentication for enhanced security.
Session timeout after a period of inactivity for security purposes.

Tasks.Description: Implement a secure login form for tenants, requiring a username and password. Input: username (string), password (string). Output: success or error message.
Develop backend authentication logic to validate tenant login credentials against the database. Input: username (string), hashed password (string). Output: validation result.

Implement two-factor authentication (2FA) feature. This includes sending a one-time password (OTP) to the tenant's registered mobile number or email after initial login credentials are verified. Input: verified user ID. Output: OTP sent confirmation.

Create a session management system that tracks tenant activity and implements timeout after a specified period of inactivity. Input: user activity signals. Output: session timeout after inactivity threshold is reached.

Set up a secure mechanism for storing passwords using hash functions (e.g., bcrypt) to ensure that tenant passwords are not stored in plaintext in the database. Input: plain password. Output: hashed password to store in the database.
Develop a user interface component for tenants to opt-in or opt-out of two-factor authentication based on their preference. Input: user preference toggle. Output: 2FA setting updated in user profile.

Integrate an external service or use an existing library to handle the sending of OTPs for two-factor authentication, ensuring it meets security standards. Input: tenant's phone number or email, OTP. Output: OTP delivery status.

Implement frontend and backend logic to handle session expiry notifications that alert the tenant prior to automatic logout due to inactivity. Input: session start time, current time. Output: notification of impending timeout.

Create a password encryption system using a robust hashing algorithm (e.g., bcrypt) to store passwords securely in the database, ensuring the login process is secure and encrypted.
Develop a 'Forgot Password' feature that allows tenants to reset their passwords. This should include sending a password reset link to the registered email, which expires after a predefined period.
Implement a password reset page that is accessible via the password reset link. The page should allow tenants to input a new password and confirm it before updating their account in the database.
Ensure the password reset process follows security best practices, such as validating the password strength and securely updating the database with the new password using encryption.
Set up session management to log out users after a period of inactivity and ensure that sessions are handled securely to prevent unauthorized access.

Ability to remove existing payment methods with confirmation prompt

Ensure that all changes, additions, or deletions of payment methods are reflected immediately in the user interface without requiring a page reload. Implement AJAX calls to update the UI dynamically.
Implement secure handling and storage of payment information using encryption and ensuring compliance with financial data protection regulations like PCI DSS.
Conduct thorough testing of the payment method management system, including both unit tests for backend APIs and UI tests to ensure that the user experience is smooth and data is handled securely.

E005.Epic Description: Enable tenants to make secure payments for rent and security deposits, view their payment history, and manage their payment methods.

E006.Epic Description: Allow tenants to submit maintenance requests, track the status of these requests, and communicate with property managers and subcontractors regarding these requests.
