Tasks.Description: Design a chat interface module that enables a chat window between tenants and subcontractors once a maintenance request is accepted. This module should be integrated into both the tenant's and subcontractor's dashboards.

Implement backend functionality to support real-time messaging. This should include creating database schemas to store messages, implementing API endpoints for sending and receiving messages, and setting up a WebSocket connection for real-time interactions.

Develop the functionality to allow file attachments in messages. Support should be added for common file types such as images (JPG, PNG) and documents (PDF). This task includes implementing file upload APIs and integrating secure file storage solutions.

Create a notification system that triggers both in-app notifications and email alerts whenever a new message is sent or received. This system should handle notifications for both tenants and subcontractors.

Ensure access control and authentication are properly managed in the chat module to prevent unauthorized users from accessing the chat. Integration with the existing authentication system is required.

Conduct thorough testing of the chat functionality across different devices and browsers to ensure compatibility and responsiveness. This includes unit testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing.

Prepare and update the system's documentation to include details about the new chat functionalities and APIs. This documentation should be made available to the development team and other stakeholders.
Deploy the new chat module to the staging environment for beta testing. Gather feedback from a select group of users to identify any issues or areas for improvement before full deployment.
Run security audits on the new chat module to ensure that all data exchanges are encrypted and that the file upload mechanism is secure against potential threats.

Plan and execute a training session for support staff and subcontractors to familiarize them with the new chat functionality and its features. This helps in ensuring a smooth transition and better user support.

E006.Epic Description: Allow tenants to submit maintenance requests, track the status of these requests, and communicate with property managers and subcontractors regarding these requests.
E006.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to provide feedback on completed maintenance jobs, so that I can express satisfaction or concerns about the service provided.
Story Acceptance Criteria: After a maintenance request is marked as completed, tenants can access a feedback form.
Tenants can rate the service (e.g., 1-5 stars) and provide written feedback.
Feedback is shared with the property manager and can be viewed by other tenants.

Tasks.Description: Create a database table for storing feedback related to maintenance requests. The table should have fields for tenant ID, request ID, rating (1-5 stars), written feedback, creation timestamp, and visibility status.

Develop a backend API endpoint to submit feedback. This endpoint accepts tenant ID, request ID, rating, and written feedback, and stores these in the feedback database table. Ensure proper authentication to secure the endpoint.
Implement a feedback submission form on the tenant's maintenance request dashboard. The form should appear only for completed maintenance requests and include fields for rating and written feedback.
Enhance the maintenance request API to update the status of a request to 'completed'. Trigger the visibility of the feedback form based on this status.

Create an API endpoint to retrieve and display feedback for property managers. This endpoint should filter feedback based on the property managed by the logged-in property manager and include tenant ratings and written feedback.
Implement functionality for tenants to view feedback given by them on completed maintenance jobs. Include filtering options by date and request ID.
Develop a permission system to ensure that feedback can only be seen by the property manager associated with the respective property and by the tenant who submitted the feedback.
Integrate user interface components for feedback rating using a star system (1-5 stars) and a text box for written feedback on the tenant's dashboard.
Ensure all user inputs for ratings and feedback are validated both client-side and server-side to prevent invalid data entry.
Set up automated tests to validate the feedback submission process, feedback visibility rules, and data storage integrity.

E006.Epic Description: Allow tenants to submit maintenance requests, track the status of these requests, and communicate with property managers and subcontractors regarding these requests.
E006.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to access the history of all my maintenance requests, so that I can refer back to previous issues and resolutions for my records.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenants can view a historical log of all maintenance requests from their dashboard.
The history includes detailed descriptions, dates submitted, actions taken, final status, and feedback provided.
The data is searchable by date range and type of maintenance.

Tasks.Description: Design a database schema to store maintenance request history, including fields for request ID, tenant ID, description, submission date, actions taken, final status, and feedback.
Implement database operations to insert, update, and retrieve maintenance request data as changes occur in the system, ensuring data integrity and consistency.
Develop a backend API endpoint to fetch the maintenance request history for a given tenant. The endpoint should accept tenant ID as input and return all related request records.
Create a search functionality in the backend API allowing filtering of maintenance request history by date range and type of maintenance, ensuring efficient data retrieval.

Design and implement a user interface on the tenant's dashboard to display the historical log of maintenance requests. This interface should include sections for detailed descriptions, dates, actions taken, final status, and feedback.
Implement interactive elements on the frontend such as drop-down menus or date pickers to enable tenants to filter the historical data by date range and type of maintenance.
Ensure the user interface for viewing maintenance request history is accessible and user-friendly, with clear labels and responsive design for different devices.
Integrate the frontend with the backend API to fetch and display the maintenance request history dynamically based on user inputs and filters.

Conduct thorough testing of the maintenance request history feature, including unit tests for API endpoints, integration tests for database operations, and user acceptance testing with real users to validate functionality and usability.

Deploy updates to the production environment following successful testing and validation stages, ensuring zero downtime and providing an update mechanism for users to access the new functionality seamlessly.

E007.Epic Description: Provide a system for tenants to schedule and manage appointments with property managers or for property visits through integration with Calendly.
E007.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to log in securely so that I can schedule appointments with property managers or for property visits.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant is able to log in using email and password.
System supports 'Forgot Password' functionality to reset password.
After login, the tenant should be redirected to the appointment booking page.

Tasks.Description: Design a secure login form for tenants that includes fields for email and password. Ensure the form design is user-friendly and accessible.
Implement backend logic to handle the secure authentication of tenant credentials. Utilize hashing for password storage and comparison during the login process.
Develop a 'Forgot Password' feature that allows tenants to reset their password. This should include sending a secure, time-limited reset link to the tenant's registered email.

Configure the system to redirect the tenant to the appointment booking page upon successful login. Ensure this transition is smooth and user feedback is provided for both successful and unsuccessful login attempts.
Implement input validation both on the client and server side to ensure the data conforms to expected formats and prevents common security issues such as SQL injection.
Set up session management to ensure that tenant sessions are securely managed and utilize HTTPS to secure data transmission between the client and server.
Test the login and password reset functionalities under different scenarios, including valid credentials, invalid credentials, session timeouts, and successful password reset flows.
Document the login and password reset processes, including any assumptions made and instructions for future maintenance or expected integrations.

E007.Epic Description: Provide a system for tenants to schedule and manage appointments with property managers or for property visits through integration with Calendly.
E007.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to view available time slots for property visits so that I can choose a slot that fits my schedule.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can see a calendar with available slots highlighted.
The calendar integrates with the property manager’s calendar via Calendly.
Tenant can view time slots for the next 30 days.

Tasks.Description: Implement an API endpoint to fetch available time slots from the property manager's Calendly account. Ensure the endpoint can access the property manager's calendar and retrieve data.
Develop a frontend component for tenants to view the calendar. This component should highlight available time slots and allow for viewing up to 30 days in advance.
Integrate the frontend calendar component with the backend API to dynamically display available time slots fetched from the property manager’s Calendly account.
Ensure the calendar display includes proper formatting and user-friendly navigation to allow tenants to easily identify and select available time slots.
Test the calendar integration to ensure that time slots update in real-time and that the system can handle multiple tenants viewing the calendar simultaneously.
Implement a caching mechanism to reduce API call frequency to Calendly, enhancing system performance and user experience.
Prepare documentation for the tenants on how to use the calendar interface to view available time slots.
Conduct user acceptance testing with feedback from actual tenants to validate the usability and functionality of the calendar viewing feature.
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations when accessing and displaying calendar data from Calendly, particularly focusing on the tenants’ and property managers’ information.
Deploy the calendar viewing feature to the production environment after completing all tests and ensuring full integration with existing tenant and property manager data systems.

E007.Epic Description: Provide a system for tenants to schedule and manage appointments with property managers or for property visits through integration with Calendly.
E007.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to schedule a property visit through Calendly integration so that the appointment is automatically synced with the property manager’s calendar.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant selects a time slot and schedules a visit directly.
Confirmation of the appointment is sent to the tenant’s email.
Property manager receives a notification about the scheduled visit.

Tasks.Description: Integrate the Calendly API into the tenant management system to allow tenants to access available property manager schedules and book appointments directly from the tenant dashboard.
Create a user interface on the tenant dashboard that displays the Calendly scheduling widget or a custom scheduling interface using the Calendly API.

Implement functionality for tenants to select and confirm a time slot for a property visit. This should involve fetching available slots from the property manager's Calendly calendar and presenting them to the tenant in a user-friendly manner.

Develop backend logic to send a confirmation email to the tenant once they schedule a visit. The email should include details of the time, date, and property address, along with any necessary contact information.

Set up a notification system to alert property managers via their preferred communication method (email, SMS, or platform notification) whenever a tenant schedules a visit. Include details such as the date and time of the visit and the tenant's contact information.
Ensure the system securely handles and stores all transactional information related to the scheduling to maintain privacy and data integrity.

Conduct thorough testing of the scheduling interface to ensure that time slots are correctly synchronized between the tenant’s interface and the property manager’s Calendly account. This should include testing for different time zones and handling conflicts.
Implement error handling for the scheduling feature to manage issues such as API failures, network errors, or scheduling conflicts, providing clear feedback and alternatives to the tenant.
Document the scheduling process flow and provide a help or FAQ section for tenants on how to use the scheduling feature, covering common questions and troubleshooting tips.
Review and ensure compliance with all relevant data protection regulations to safeguard tenant and property manager information processed through the Calendly integration.

E007.Epic Description: Provide a system for tenants to schedule and manage appointments with property managers or for property visits through integration with Calendly.
E007.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to cancel or reschedule my appointment so that I can manage changes in my availability.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can access their booked appointments from their dashboard.
Each appointment has options to reschedule or cancel.
Notifications are sent to both tenant and property manager upon cancellation or rescheduling.

Tasks.Description: Implement a dashboard view for tenants to list all their booked appointments. This should include details like date, time, and the ability to interact with each appointment.
Develop functionality within the tenant dashboard that allows tenants to cancel or reschedule their appointments. These options should be clearly visible and accessible for each listed appointment.
Create backend logic to handle the cancellation or rescheduling of appointments. This should update the appointment status in the database and free up the previously booked slot if rescheduled.

Integrate notification system to send automated confirmations to both tenants and property managers when an appointment is cancelled or rescheduled. This should include email and in-app notifications.
Ensure that the Calendly API is properly integrated to reflect changes made within the platform in real-time, syncing the new appointment details back to the property manager's Calendly calendar.
Set up error handling for failed cancellation or rescheduling attempts, providing clear and informative messages to the user on what went wrong and possible actions to correct it.
Conduct thorough testing of the cancellation and rescheduling functionality, including edge cases like attempting to reschedule an appointment to a time slot that has become unavailable.
Implement security measures to ensure that only the tenant who booked the appointment can cancel or reschedule it, preventing unauthorized access and modifications.

E007.Epic Description: Provide a system for tenants to schedule and manage appointments with property managers or for property visits through integration with Calendly.
E007.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive reminders about my appointments so that I do not miss scheduled visits.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant receives an email reminder 24 hours before the appointment.
A reminder notification is pushed through the application 1 hour before the appointment.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to store appointment details including tenant ID, property manager ID, appointment date and time, and reminder status.
Develop a function to add new appointments into the database, capturing all necessary details like tenant ID, property manager ID, appointment date and time.
Create an API endpoint to allow scheduling of appointments from the frontend application. This endpoint should handle requests to create new appointments and store them in the database.

Implement an email notification system that integrates with an SMTP server to send an email reminder 24 hours before the scheduled appointment. This function should query the database for appointments happening in the next 24 hours and send reminders accordingly.

Develop a function to push in-app notifications 1 hour before the appointment. This should interface with the mobile application's notification service to alert tenants about the upcoming appointment.
Set up a cron job or a scheduled task that triggers the email reminder function and the in-app reminder function at specified intervals (24 hours and 1 hour before appointments, respectively).
Create automated tests to verify the accuracy and reliability of the reminder system, ensuring that notifications are sent at the correct times and contain accurate appointment details.
Develop a user interface on the tenant dashboard for viewing and managing scheduled appointments, including the functionality to view the status of reminders (sent or pending).
Integrate the appointment scheduling feature with Calendly using the Calendly API to synchronize appointment slots and availabilities directly on the tenant dashboard.
Implement security measures to ensure that appointment data is transmitted securely and that access to scheduling and reminder functionalities is properly authenticated.

E007.Epic Description: Provide a system for tenants to schedule and manage appointments with property managers or for property visits through integration with Calendly.
E007.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to submit feedback after a property visit so that I can share my experience and any concerns.
Story Acceptance Criteria: After the appointment, the tenant receives a prompt to submit feedback.
Tenant can rate the visit and submit comments through a form in the app.
Feedback is stored and can be accessed by the property manager for review.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface form for feedback submission that includes rating scales and text boxes for comments. Ensure the form is accessible and intuitive for tenants to use after they have visited a property.
Implement a backend API endpoint to receive and store feedback data submitted through the feedback form. This endpoint should accept parameters such as tenant ID, property ID, rating, and comments.

Develop a feature that triggers a feedback prompt to the tenant's app notification system immediately after their scheduled property visit. This prompt should direct them to the feedback form within the app.
Store the feedback data in a database with appropriate relations to the tenant and property entities. Ensure data integrity and security according to best practices.

Provide property managers access to the feedback through their dashboard. This should include functionalities to view individual feedback entries and summary statistics about feedback received for their properties.
Implement input validation on the feedback form to ensure that all required fields are filled and the data format is correct before submission.
Configure the server to send a confirmation message to the tenant's app once the feedback is successfully submitted and stored.

Create a testing plan to verify that the feedback prompt is accurately triggered after the appointment, the form handles inputs as expected, the data is correctly stored, and property managers can adequately access and review the feedback.
Ensure compliance with privacy laws and regulations when handling tenant feedback, especially concerning personal data and the permissions required to access and store such information.

E008.Epic Description: Implement a notification system to alert tenants about important events such as lease renewals, payment due dates, and maintenance request updates.
E008.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive notifications about upcoming lease renewals so that I can make timely decisions about extending my stay or moving out.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Notification is automatically triggered 60 days before the lease expiry date.
Tenant receives the notification via both email and in-app notification.
Tenant can directly navigate to the lease renewal section from the notification.

Tasks.Description: Create a database field for lease expiration dates for each tenant lease agreement.
Develop a scheduled job that runs daily to check for leases expiring in 60 days.
Implement a notification system that triggers an email and an in-app notification when the scheduled job finds a lease nearing expiration.
Ensure the notification content includes a direct link or button that redirects the tenant to the lease renewal section of the platform.
Set up email templates for lease renewal notifications that include personalized tenant details and lease expiry information.
Develop the frontend functionality to display in-app notifications, ensuring these are accessible and visible upon tenant login.
Integrate the notification system with the platform's existing user authentication and session management to ensure notifications are securely delivered to the correct tenant.
Test the notification system to confirm that notifications are sent accurately 60 days before the lease expires, and that links in notifications redirect correctly.
Provide an administrative interface for property managers to review and manage scheduled notifications, including modifying timings or disabling notifications if necessary.

E008.Epic Description: Implement a notification system to alert tenants about important events such as lease renewals, payment due dates, and maintenance request updates.
E008.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive reminders about upcoming rent payment due dates so that I can ensure timely payments without incurring any late fees.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Reminder notifications are sent 7 days before the due date.
Additional reminder if the rent is not paid, 1 day before the due date.
Tenant receives these alerts via email and in-app notifications.
Links to the payment portal are included in the notifications.

Tasks.Description: Create a function to calculate the due date for rent payments and schedule the reminder notifications. The function should accept the due date as input and output the dates when the reminders should be sent.

Develop a notification service that sends out email and in-app notifications. The service should take tenant details, message content, and notification type (email, in-app) as inputs and handle the sending process.

Implement a database query or API call to retrieve tenant payment details and status to determine if the rent has been paid or if a payment reminder should be sent out. Input parameters should include tenant ID and due date, and the output should be the payment status.

Design an email template for payment reminders that includes dynamic fields for tenant name, due date, amount due, and a link to the payment portal. This template will be used by the notification service.

Set up a scheduler to automatically trigger the payment reminder notifications based on the dates calculated by the due date function. This scheduler should interface with the notification service to send out the reminders on the specified dates.

Create a function to generate links to the payment portal which will be included in the reminder notifications. This function should accept the tenant ID and output a personalized link to the payment portal.
Integrate the notification system with the existing tenant management system to ensure that reminders are sent to the correct email addresses and devices associated with each tenant.

Implement logging for the notification system to track when reminders are sent out and any failures in the notification process. This will help in troubleshooting and ensuring the reliability of the system.
Conduct testing of the notification system to ensure that reminders are sent correctly 7 days and 1 day before the due date, and that the links to the payment portal function as expected.
Review security measures for the notification system to ensure that tenant data is handled securely, especially in the transmission of notifications over email and in-app channels.

E008.Epic Description: Implement a notification system to alert tenants about important events such as lease renewals, payment due dates, and maintenance request updates.
E008.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive updates about the status of my maintenance requests so that I can stay informed about when issues will be resolved.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant receives an immediate notification when a maintenance request is accepted, rejected, or completed.
Each notification includes details about the request status and expected next steps or completion date.
Notifications are available through both in-app notifications and emails.

Tasks.Description: Design a notification schema in the database that includes fields for notification type, tenant ID, maintenance request ID, status, details, timestamp, and read/unread status.
Implement a function 'create_notification' that accepts parameters including tenant ID, maintenance request ID, status, and details, and stores this information in the notification schema.
Develop an API endpoint for fetching notifications for a tenant that filters notifications by tenant ID and sorts them by timestamp.

Integrate the notification creation function within the maintenance request handling logic such that a notification is generated whenever a maintenance request is accepted, rejected, or marked as completed.
Create a service that formats the notification details to include specific information about the maintenance request status change and next steps or completion date.

Implement an email notification system using an SMTP server or an email service provider like SendGrid to send notifications to the tenant's registered email address whenever there is a status update on their maintenance request.
Develop a frontend feature in the tenant dashboard to display the latest notifications; include functionality to mark notifications as read/unread.
Ensure that in-app notifications are pushed to the tenant's device using a service like Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) to allow real-time notification delivery.
Test the notification system thoroughly to ensure that notifications are generated and sent correctly based on different status changes in maintenance requests.
Document the API endpoints and the notification system mechanism to aid in future maintenance and updates of the system.

E008.Epic Description: Implement a notification system to alert tenants about important events such as lease renewals, payment due dates, and maintenance request updates.
E008.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive general announcements related to the property so that I am informed about matters affecting my tenancy.
Story Acceptance Criteria: General announcements such as changes in management, major construction, or policy changes are communicated via notifications.
Tenant receives these through email and in-app notifications.
Each notification includes a summary of the announcement and links to detailed information if available.

Tasks.Description: Design the database schema to store general announcements including fields for title, summary, detailed description, date of issue, and type of announcement (management changes, construction updates, etc.).
Implement a backend service to handle the creation, update, and retrieval of general announcements. Ensure REST API endpoints are secure and only accessible by authorized users.

Develop an email notification system that triggers sending emails to tenants when a new announcement is made. The email should include the announcement summary and a link to view more details in the platform.

Create an in-app notification system where notifications about new announcements are pushed to tenant dashboards. Notifications should be stored in the database with read/unread status and linked to the tenant's account.

Develop a user interface component for tenants to view detailed information about each announcement. This should include the ability to access this component through both email links and in-app notifications.

Implement functionality for tenants to configure their notification preferences, enabling them to opt-in or opt-out of receiving notifications about general announcements through email or in-app methods.

Ensure all data handling, especially email addresses and notification preferences, comply with privacy and data protection regulations. Implement necessary security measures such as data encryption and secure data transfer protocols.

Perform comprehensive testing to validate the functionality of the announcement system, including unit tests for backend logic, integration tests for API endpoints, and UI tests for the frontend components.
Prepare documentation for the system administrators that details how to create and manage announcements and for tenants on how to use the system to receive and view notifications.

E008.Epic Description: Implement a notification system to alert tenants about important events such as lease renewals, payment due dates, and maintenance request updates.
E008.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to customize my notification preferences so that I only receive relevant alerts and can choose the notification methods that suit me best.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenants can access a settings menu to turn on/off specific types of notifications.
Tenants can choose the method of notification (email, in-app, both).
Changes to settings must be saved and take effect immediately.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface for the notification settings menu where tenants can view and toggle different types of notifications such as lease renewals, payment due dates, and maintenance updates.
Develop a backend service to handle the retrieval and storage of user notification settings. This should include endpoints to get current settings, update settings, and save settings to the database.

Create a mechanism in both the frontend and backend to allow tenants to choose their preferred notification delivery method (email, in-app, or both). This includes UI components for selection and backend logic for saving preferences.

Implement functionality to ensure that changes in the notification settings by tenants are saved immediately and reliably to the backend database. This includes implementing transactional integrity and confirmation responses to the user interface.
Integrate the notification settings module with the overall tenant profile management system, ensuring seamless access and user experience within the tenant’s dashboard.

Perform rigorous testing of the notification settings feature to ensure that changes are correctly captured in the system and reflected immediately. This includes unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing.

Deploy the notification settings update to the staging environment, conduct thorough testing with simulated real-user workflows to ensure the system handles settings changes correctly under different scenarios.
Prepare and update system documentation related to the notification settings feature, detailing the functionalities, technical implementation, and user guides for future reference and maintenance.

E009.Epic Description: Allow tenants to give feedback on properties and services, and view reviews from other tenants to help them make informed decisions.
E009.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to submit feedback on my rental property and services provided so that I can share my experiences with the property management and other potential tenants.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant is able to access a feedback submission form from their dashboard.
Tenant can rate aspects such as cleanliness, service responsiveness, and amenities.
Tenant can leave detailed textual feedback.
Feedback submission updates the property's overall rating in real-time.
Feedback is immediately visible in the tenant's feedback history.

Tasks.Description: Design a feedback submission form accessible from the tenant's dashboard. The form should include fields for rating cleanliness, service responsiveness, amenities, and an input area for detailed textual feedback.

Implement functionality in the backend to process feedback form submissions. This includes capturing the ratings and textual feedback, updating the property's overall rating, and storing the feedback in the tenant's history.

Create a database schema to store tenant feedback. Ensure that each entry links to the tenant's ID, the property ID, and includes fields for cleanliness, service responsiveness, amenities ratings, textual feedback, and timestamps.

Develop real-time updating logic for the property's overall rating based on the latest feedback submitted. This involves calculating the average for each aspect (cleanliness, service responsiveness, amenities) whenever new feedback is added.

Ensure that upon successful submission of feedback, the feedback is immediately visible in the tenant's feedback history. Implement this by fetching and displaying the latest feedback entries in the tenant's dashboard section.

E009.Epic Description: Allow tenants to give feedback on properties and services, and view reviews from other tenants to help them make informed decisions.
E009.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to view reviews and ratings from other tenants for a specific property so that I can make informed decisions about potential rentals.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can access a reviews section from the property details page.
Reviews display both ratings and textual feedback.
Reviews include the date of submission and the first name of the reviewer for authenticity.
Tenant can filter reviews by date and rating.

Tasks.Description: Design a database schema to store reviews, including fields for property ID, tenant ID, rating, text feedback, date of submission, and reviewer's first name. Ensure the schema supports filtering by date and rating.
Implement API endpoints to fetch reviews based on property ID. Include query parameters to filter results by date and rating.
Create a secure authentication method to verify that the tenant is logged in before allowing access to the reviews section.

Develop the front-end user interface for the reviews section on the property details page. Include elements for displaying ratings, textual feedback, date of submission, and the first name of the reviewer.
Implement a filtering functionality on the front-end that interacts with the API to fetch and display filtered review data based on selected criteria (date and rating).
Test the review display functionality to ensure data is accurately retrieved from the database and correctly displayed on the property details page according to the specified filters.
Ensure that the review system adheres to privacy standards by only displaying the first name of the reviewer and any other non-sensitive information.
Document the API endpoints and front-end functionality in the system's technical documentation to assist future developers and maintainers.

E009.Epic Description: Allow tenants to give feedback on properties and services, and view reviews from other tenants to help them make informed decisions.
E009.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to edit or delete my previous feedback submissions so that I can correct errors or update my opinions as situations change.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can view their own past reviews and ratings via their profile.
Tenant has the option to edit or delete their submissions.
Changes in reviews are reflected immediately across the platform.
Notifications are sent to property managers when a review is edited or deleted.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface on the tenant's profile page for viewing their past reviews and ratings. Include functionality to list all reviews in a scrollable format, detailing the property reviewed, the rating given, and the textual feedback provided.

Develop a backend service to fetch all reviews and ratings from the database associated with the logged-in tenant's user ID. Ensure the service handles data retrieval securely and efficiently, corresponding to the tenant's specific reviews and ratings.

Implement edit functionality for each review listed on the tenant's profile. This includes an 'Edit' button that opens a form pre-populated with the existing review and rating, allowing the tenant to modify their feedback.

Implement delete functionality for each review listed on the tenant's profile. Include a 'Delete' button alongside a confirmation dialog to prevent accidental deletions. Ensure the deletion process removes the review data from the database securely.
Create API endpoints to support the editing and deletion of reviews. These endpoints should handle requests securely, verifying the tenant's identity and authorization to alter the specified review.
Update the frontend to dynamically reflect changes in the reviews list immediately after an edit or deletion is made without the need to manually refresh the page.

Implement a notification system that alerts property managers via email and in-app notifications when a tenant edits or deletes a review. Include details of the change and a direct link to the updated review in the notification.

Ensure comprehensive logging of all edit and delete operations on reviews for audit trails. Log entries should include the user ID, timestamp, type of operation (edit/delete), and the ID of the review affected.

Conduct thorough testing to verify that the review edit and delete functionalities work as expected across different devices and browsers. Include security testing to ensure that unauthorized users cannot edit or delete reviews.

Prepare documentation for the review management features detailing the workflow, endpoints, and methods used for editing and deleting reviews, including information on the security measures implemented.

E009.Epic Description: Allow tenants to give feedback on properties and services, and view reviews from other tenants to help them make informed decisions.
E009.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive notifications when property management responds to my feedback so that I can stay updated on dialogues concerning my reviews.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Notification is sent to the tenant's dashboard and email when a response is made.
Tenant can directly access the response through links provided in the notification.
Tenant can reply to the response from the property manager.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to store feedback, responses, and notification settings for each tenant. This includes creating tables for feedback, responses, and user notification preferences with appropriate relationships and indices for performance optimization.

Develop a backend service to handle the creation and storage of feedback and responses. This service should include methods to post feedback, post responses to feedback, and fetch feedback and responses for display on the tenant's dashboard.

Implement an API endpoint to receive and send notifications related to feedback responses. This endpoint should handle incoming requests to send notifications and integrate with the email service provider for sending email notifications.

Create a function to generate notification messages that include links directing the tenant to the feedback response. This function should dynamically generate URLs based on the feedback ID and tenant ID to ensure direct access to the relevant feedback thread.

Develop a front-end module on the tenant's dashboard to display notifications. This module should include interactive elements that allow the tenant to view the response directly or navigate to a detailed view to reply or read more.

Integrate email notification capabilities using an email service provider (e.g., SendGrid, MailChimp). Set up templates for feedback response notifications that include links as described in the acceptance criteria.
Implement a feature for tenants to adjust their notification preferences in their profile settings, allowing them to opt in or out of receiving notifications via email or dashboard alerts.

Ensure proper authentication and authorization checks are in place for accessing and managing feedback and notifications, so that tenants can only see and respond to feedback related to their own tenancy.

Conduct thorough testing to verify that notifications are sent correctly when a response is made to tenant feedback, both in the form of an email and a dashboard notification, and that the links in the notifications lead to the correct feedback details.
Document the API endpoints and notification system behavior in the developer documentation to assist future development and debugging efforts.

E009.Epic Description: Allow tenants to give feedback on properties and services, and view reviews from other tenants to help them make informed decisions.
E009.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want a dashboard widget that summarizes all my given feedback, average ratings I've provided, and any responses from landlords or property managers so that I can easily track my interactions.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard widget shows a summary of all feedback given by the tenant.
Widget displays average rating and number of reviews submitted.
Tenant receives visual notification on the widget for any new responses from property managers.

Tasks.Description: Design the UI layout for the tenant dashboard widget that will display the summary of all feedback given by the tenant. Include sections for average rating, number of reviews submitted, and visual notifications for new responses.

Implement the backend logic to fetch and aggregate all feedback data related to a specific tenant. This includes computing the average rating and counting the total number of reviews submitted by the tenant.

Develop a notification system on the backend that detects new responses from property managers to the tenant's feedback. This system should trigger a visual notification on the tenant's dashboard widget.
Create API endpoints to support the fetching of feedback data and notification statuses for the dashboard widget. Ensure these endpoints are secure and only accessible by the authenticated tenant.
Integrate the frontend dashboard widget with the backend services using AJAX to dynamically display the fetched data without needing to reload the page.
Implement comprehensive unit tests for both backend logic and frontend integration to ensure data is fetched and displayed correctly, and that notifications are triggered as expected.
Conduct a UX review of the dashboard widget to ensure it is user-friendly and the information is displayed in an easily digestible format. Collect feedback from a focus group of tenants.
Deploy the changes to a staging environment and conduct integration testing to check for any interaction issues with existing dashboard functionalities.
Prepare and update the system documentation with details on the new dashboard widget functionalities, including the process flow and any relevant API endpoints.
Plan and execute a training session for the support team on the new dashboard widget to ensure they can assist tenants with any questions or issues related to the new functionality.

E010.Epic Description: Integrate with third-party services like SingleKey to verify tenant credentials during the lease application process.
E010.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to initiate my profile verification using SingleKey during the lease application process so that I can ensure my credentials are validated and increase my trustworthiness to potential landlords.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant initiates verification from the tenant dashboard.
Tenant is redirected to the SingleKey integration interface.
Tenant inputs required information and submits it for verification.
Tenant receives a notification upon successful submission of their verification request.

Tasks.Description: Design the UI for the tenant dashboard button to initiate the verification process. This includes a clearly labeled button and tooltips to guide the tenant on its purpose.
Implement redirection functionality in the tenant dashboard that connects to the SingleKey verification interface when the verification button is clicked.

Develop a form on the SingleKey integration interface for tenants to input required verification information. This form should include all necessary fields such as name, address, and government-issued ID, and it should validate inputs for format and completeness.

Create a backend service to handle the submission of verification data from the SingleKey integration interface to SingleKey's API. This service should handle data serialization, API request execution, and error handling.

Develop a notification system to inform tenants about the successful submission of their verification request. This system should trigger an in-app notification and an email confirmation once the verification data is successfully submitted to SingleKey.

Implement security measures to ensure that all personal data transferred between the tenant dashboard, the application backend, and SingleKey is encrypted and conforms to relevant data protection regulations.
Conduct integration testing to verify that the tenant dashboard correctly interacts with the SingleKey API, including successful data submission and error handling for failed submissions.

Prepare user documentation that explains how tenants can initiate and complete their profile verification using SingleKey, highlighting the details required and the significance of each step in the process.

Deploy the new verification feature to a staging environment for acceptance testing, ensuring it meets all specified acceptance criteria and integrates seamlessly with existing tenant dashboard functionalities.
Collect feedback from initial users in the staging environment and make necessary adjustments based on their experiences and difficulties, if any, with the verification process.

E010.Epic Description: Integrate with third-party services like SingleKey to verify tenant credentials during the lease application process.
E010.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive real-time updates on my verification status so that I am informed of the current progress and can take necessary actions if there are any issues.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant receives an in-app notification and email regarding the status of the verification.
Tenant can view the current status of their verification process on their dashboard.
The system updates the tenant's profile status automatically based on the verification results (verified or needs additional info).

Tasks.Description: Design and implement an API endpoint to handle the retrieval of verification status updates from SingleKey. This endpoint should securely fetch and return the latest verification status for a specific tenant.
Develop a service in the backend that periodically checks for updates in the verification status from SingleKey and updates the tenant's profile status in the database accordingly.

Implement a notification system in the backend that triggers in-app notifications and sends emails to tenants whenever there is a change in their verification status. This system must handle both successful verifications and notifications requiring additional information from the tenant.

Create a user interface component on the tenant's dashboard that dynamically displays the current verification status. This component should update in real-time as the backend processes new information received from SingleKey.

Ensure all data transmitted between the platform and SingleKey is encrypted and secure to protect tenant information during the verification process. Implement necessary security measures such as HTTPS and data encryption.
Integrate the SingleKey API with the platform's backend, ensuring that the system can handle and process verification requests and responses efficiently and correctly.

Conduct thorough testing to verify that the verification status updates are accurately reflected on the tenant's dashboard and that all notifications (in-app and email) are sent correctly according to the change in status.

Deploy these new features to the staging environment and conduct integration testing with the SingleKey service to ensure that interactions between the systems are functioning as expected under various scenarios.

Prepare user documentation and help guides explaining how tenants can view and understand their verification status on the platform, and what steps they need to take if additional information is required for their verification.
Review and ensure compliance with data protection laws for handling and storing tenant verification information, especially sensitive data exchanged with SingleKey.

E010.Epic Description: Integrate with third-party services like SingleKey to verify tenant credentials during the lease application process.
E010.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to pay for the verification process through the platform if the property owner requires tenants to bear the cost, so that I can complete necessary financial transactions securely and conveniently.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant is prompted to make a payment if the property owner has set the verification payment responsibility to the tenant.
Tenant can use Stripe integration to make the payment securely.
Tenant receives confirmation of the payment.
System records the transaction in the tenant's payment history.

Tasks.Description: Implement a feature to prompt tenants about the payment requirement when the property owner has opted for tenant-paid verification. This prompt should appear during the verification process and clearly state that the cost will be borne by the tenant.

Integrate the Stripe API to handle secure payment processing. Ensure that the payment interface accepts all major credit and debit cards, and provide clear instructions for entering payment information.
Develop and implement a confirmation message that appears after a successful payment. This message should thank the tenant for their payment and confirm the transaction amount.

Create functionality to record the payment transaction in the tenant's payment history. This includes storing details such as the date, amount paid, and purpose of the payment. Ensure the data is securely stored and easily retrievable for the tenant via their dashboard.

E010.Epic Description: Integrate with third-party services like SingleKey to verify tenant credentials during the lease application process.
E010.Story Title: Error Handling and Support for Verification
E010.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive helpful error messages and access support if the verification process encounters issues, so that I can resolve any problems efficiently and complete my profile verification.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System displays clear and specific error messages if the verification cannot be processed.
Tenant can access a FAQ or Help section regarding common verification issues.
Tenant has the option to contact support directly from the verification page.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement error handling logic in the verification process to identify and categorize different types of verification failures. This includes setting up specific error codes and messages for scenarios like network failure, incomplete data submission, or invalid data formats.

Create a user interface component on the tenant dashboard for displaying error messages. This component should be capable of showing clear, actionable error messages based on the specific error codes generated by the system during the verification process.

Develop a FAQ section related to the verification process. This includes gathering common verification issues and their solutions, organizing this information in a clear and accessible format, and integrating this section within the tenant's dashboard or a dedicated help page.

Implement a direct support contact feature on the verification page. This task involves setting up a support form or chat option that tenants can use to get in touch with customer support directly from the verification interface. Include fields for the tenant to describe their issue, attach screenshots, and submit their contact details.

Ensure all front-end components for error display, FAQ access, and direct support contact are responsive and accessible, meeting accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1. Test these components across different devices and screen sizes to ensure a consistent user experience.

Integrate backend services with the front-end components to dynamically fetch and display the relevant error messages, FAQs, and enable real-time communication with support personnel. This includes API development and integration testing.

Prepare and maintain documentation for the system's error handling and support features. This includes technical documentation for future developers and user guides for tenants to understand how to navigate issues during the verification process.

E010.Epic Description: Integrate with third-party services like SingleKey to verify tenant credentials during the lease application process.
E010.Story Description: As a Tenant, I want the ability to resubmit verification documents if my initial submission is rejected, so that I can correct any errors and complete the verification process.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tenant is notified of the need for resubmission and the reasons for rejection.
Tenant can resubmit the documents through the SingleKey interface.
Tenant receives confirmation of the resubmission.
System updates the verification status accordingly.

Tasks.Description: Implement a notification system that alerts the tenant when their verification documents are rejected. The notification should specify the reasons for rejection and instructions on how to resubmit the documents.

Develop the user interface on the tenant's dashboard for document resubmission. This interface should integrate with the SingleKey API to allow tenants to upload their documents directly through the platform.
Create a backend service to handle the reception and processing of the resubmitted documents. This service should validate the documents and forward them to SingleKey for verification.

Implement a confirmation message feature that notifies the tenant once their resubmission has been successfully received and processed. This message should be displayed on their dashboard and optionally sent via email.

Update the tenant's verification status in the system once the resubmitted documents are processed and a response is received from SingleKey. Ensure that this status update is reflected in real-time on the tenant's dashboard.
